2090210.desc: Threads of Time is an era-spanning, turn-based RPG inspired by the timeless classics. Embark on a journey through time, gather a party of charismatic heroes from across ages, and uncover a plot that threatens to unravel the past, present and future.
2090210.name: Threads of Time

20920.desc: A time of untold chaos has come. Mighty forces clash behind the scenes in a struggle for power and influence. The Northern Kingdoms mobilize for war. But armies on the march are not enough to stop a bloody conspiracy...
20920.name: The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings Enhanced Edition

2100.desc: Discover a new breed of Action-RPG game powered by an enhanced version of the Source™ Engine by Valve. Set in the Might & Magic® universe, players will experience ferocious combat in a dark and immersive fantasy environment. Swords, Stealth, Sorcery. Choose your way to kill.
2100.name: Dark Messiah of Might & Magic

21000.desc: When all the villains in Arkham Asylum team up and break loose, only the dynamic duo is bold enough to take them on to save Gotham City. The fun of LEGO, the drama of Batman and the uniqueness of the combination makes for a comical and exciting adventure in LEGO Batman: The Videogame.
21000.name: LEGO® Batman™: The Videogame

21090.desc: Experience the original F.E.A.R. along with F.E.A.R. Extraction Point and F.E.A.R. Perseus Mandate.
21090.name: F.E.A.R.

2109770.desc: Go back in time to a war-torn medieval era with a vast arsenal of modern weapons, change the course of history, and save the future in this epic action/strategy sandbox. Build your kingdom, grab a gun, and lead an army of thousands into massive, real-time simulated battles — solo or in co-op.
2109770.name: Kingmakers

211500.desc: RaceRoom is free to download and built on true-to-life physics and Force Feedback. Drive DTM, FIA WTCC, WTCR and a huge library of cars and tracks—including the most up-to-date Nordschleife. Jump in, race instantly, and expand your garage with a massive selection of content.
211500.name: RaceRoom Racing Experience

2139460.desc: Once Human is a Strange Worlds Survival Game set in a strange, post-apocalyptic future. Unite with friends to fight monstrous enemies, uncover secret plots, compete for resources, and build your own territory. Once, you were merely human. Now, you have the power to remake the world.
2139460.name: Once Human

2141130.desc: Drive a 40-ton semi hauling cargo across the coastal plains of the American South, managing multiple jobs, trailers, and routes. Grow reputation from rookie to veteran owner-operator, dodging disasters and rivals to become the hero of the open road.
2141130.name: Road Kings

2153760.desc: Wood needed! Return to the green roots of Stronghold in this narrative prequel to the original 'castle sim'. Immerse yourself in a cinematic campaign, hone your siegecraft with new mechanics in skirmish mode and customise your castles with a wide selection of castle pieces and cosmetics.
2153760.name: Stronghold 4

2161710.desc: Welcome to Port Desire, a city that doesn't belong to anyone, but where everyone wants a piece. You’re Grey Harker, an ex-military attempting to live a quiet life after near fatal injuries in the field. All you want now is peace - but in a city of no laws, what you want isn’t always what you get.
2161710.name: NO LAW

2165810.desc: Streets of Rogue 2 is a crazy, immersive RPG sandbox set in a vast randomly generated open world where freedom and fun are dialed up to 11. Fight, sneak, hack, farm, build, steal, or talk your way to power as you try to topple a corrupt president in countless possible ways – solo or with friends.
2165810.name: Streets of Rogue 2

21690.desc: This game is a port of the Games for Windows - Live version that was released in 2009. If you buy the Untold Stories Bundle here on Steam, it will be the same as upgrading to Resident Evil 5 Gold Edition.
21690.name: Resident Evil 5

2173850.desc: A high-risk, high reward shoot em up as you power yourself and your enemies up to bring utter chaos to the battlefield!
2173850.name: ASSAULT SHELL 2

2174510.desc: Manage your driver in short, tactical races. Rapidly choose from dozens of upgrades each race. Use tire compounds to shape your strategy. Machine-learned drivers make every race unpredictable. Can you become the Champion?
2174510.name: Backseat Champions

2179480.desc: The zombies ended the world. You're going to switch it back on. Ardem is an open-world zombie survival game in an immersive handcrafted world. Restore electricity, rebuild vehicles, construct your base, and permanently reshape the world. Solo, co-op, or on up-to-64-player PvE, PvP, and RP servers.
2179480.name: Ardem

218230.desc: PlanetSide 2 is an all-out planetary war, where thousands of players battle as one across enormous continents. Utilize infantry, ground and air vehicles, and teamwork to destroy your enemies in this revolutionary first-person shooter on a massive scale.
218230.name: PlanetSide 2

2183900.desc: Embody the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine. Unleash deadly abilities and devastating weaponry to obliterate the relentless Tyranid swarms. Defend the Imperium in spectacular third-person action in solo or multiplayer modes.
2183900.name: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2

218620.desc: PAYDAY 2 is an action-packed, four-player co-op shooter that once again lets gamers don the masks of the original PAYDAY crew - Dallas, Hoxton, Wolf and Chains - as they descend on Washington DC for an epic crime spree.
218620.name: PAYDAY 2

2186680.desc: Made in a close partnership with Games Workshop, Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader is a story-rich classical RPG from Owlcat Games, developers of the critically acclaimed game, Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous.
2186680.name: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader

2195710.desc: Peer beyond the veil and experience the ethereal in The Ghost and The Phoenix, a captivating neo-classical top-down shooter. Navigate the realms between life and death in this supernatural action-packed adventure.
2195710.name: The Ghost and The Phoenix

219990.desc: Enter an apocalyptic fantasy world where humanity is on the brink of extinction, iron is valued above gold and trust is hard earned. This ARPG features complex character development, hundreds of unique items, crafting and quests with choice & consequence.
219990.name: Grim Dawn

220.desc: Reawakened from stasis in the occupied metropolis of City 17, Gordon Freeman is joined by Alyx Vance as he leads a desperate human resistance. Experience the landmark first-person shooter packed with immersive world-building, boundary-pushing physics, and exhilarating combat.
220.name: Half-Life 2

2200.desc: The greatest warriors of all time and space have been summoned to battle for the amusement of an ancient alien race. Wield a variety of guns and power-ups as you fight for glory against ruthless combatants in this fast-paced single-player and multiplayer FPS.
2200.name: Quake III Arena

2208810.desc: Return to Isla Nublar the day after the events of the beloved 1993 Jurassic Park film and survive thrilling first-person action as InGen scientist Dr. Maya Joshi in this single-player action-adventure game.
2208810.name: Jurassic Park: Survival

2210.desc: As part of the elite Rhino Squad, you must spearhead Earth’s military invasion of a hostile alien homeworld. But, in this desperate war for humanity’s survival against an unrelenting enemy, you may discover that the only way to defeat them...is to become one of them.
2210.name: Quake 4

221100.desc: How long can you survive a post-apocalyptic world? A land overrun with an infected "zombie" population, where you compete with other survivors for limited resources. Will you team up with strangers and stay strong together? Or play as a lone wolf to avoid betrayal? This is DayZ – this is your story.
221100.name: DayZ

2212400.desc: Chaotic 2v2 action where all 4 players clash at the exact same time! Master the frame-perfect parry mechanic and equip one of 6 powerful Gems to alter your team's playstyle. Play with 3 friends in smooth online matches powered by GGPO rollback netcode.
2212400.name: Gemion Function

22300.desc: Vault-Tec engineers have worked around the clock on an interactive reproduction of Wasteland life for you to enjoy from the comfort of your own vault. Included is an expansive world, unique combat, shockingly realistic visuals, tons of player choice, and an incredible cast of dynamic characters.
22300.name: Fallout 3

2231020.desc: Step into a vast, dynamic medieval sandbox set in the age of the Hundred Years' War. Explore a brutal but beautiful, historically grounded Europe, command armies in massive battles, leave a mark the chroniclers can't ignore as you make your name one fight at a time. What story will you write?
2231020.name: Chronicles: Medieval

22320.desc: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind® Game of the Year Edition includes Morrowind plus all of the content from the Bloodmoon and Tribunal expansions. The original Mod Construction Set is not included in this package. An epic, open-ended single-player RPG, Morrowind allows you to create and play any kind of character imaginable.
22320.name: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind® Game of the Year Edition

2235430.desc: A psychological survival horror game set in an eerie, isolated 90’s Polish town consumed by an ominous presence. You’ve come looking for answers, but everyone seems possessed by something foul. Explore the festering town, interrogate locals and fight ungodly manifestations to get to the truth.
2235430.name: Holstin

2236840.desc: Arm a tiny drone past common sense, then shoot absolutely everything. The research facility can reconsider science afterward.
2236840.name: Little Drone TuTuTu

2239770.desc: Don’t Starve returns with an all-new uncompromising survival experience. Band together with friends to craft, farm, build and explore a world filled with strange creatures, lurking shadows, and dynamic environmental dangers.
2239770.name: Don't Starve Elsewhere

224260.desc: The chances of you surviving this all out war of society and the undead are slim to none. Already, there are millions of the walking dead shambling about, searching for food to eat. There's no known cure. One bite can possibly end it all for you. However, you aren't alone in this nightmare.
224260.name: No More Room in Hell

2246340.desc: The unbridled force of nature runs wild and relentless, with environments transforming drastically from one moment to the next. This is a story of monsters and humans and their struggles to live in harmony in a world of duality.
2246340.name: Monster Hunter Wilds

2270.desc: World War II rages. The Nazis are planning to build an unstoppable, mutant army. On a mission to steal the secret plans, you were captured and imprisoned. Now, a lucky break gives you the chance to escape, but a maze of passages and trigger-happy Nazis stand in your way.
2270.name: Wolfenstein 3D

2272360.desc: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.
2272360.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV

227300.desc: Travel across Europe as king of the road, a trucker who delivers important cargo across impressive distances! With dozens of cities to explore, your endurance, skill and speed will all be pushed to their limits.
227300.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2

227940.desc: Shoot, blow sh!t up, fly or bark orders in the ultimate Free-to-Play, large scale, multiplayer, shooter experience. Thousands of players in multiple battles fighting one massive war of nations. The first to capture 15 cities takes the glory.
227940.name: Heroes & Generals

2280.desc: Developed by id Software, and originally released in 1993 and 1994, the definitive, newly enhanced versions of DOOM + DOOM II are available as a combined product.
2280.name: DOOM + DOOM II

2280360.desc: Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story blends narrative adventure with brutal top-down action. In a crime-ridden town of humans and animals, you're a resident by day and a hitman by night. Uncover your buried past before it catches up with you.
2280360.name: Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story

2295170.desc: Awaken with no memories inside the Vitromotus, a vast underground world created as a magical dungeon where death no longer lasts. Explore its depths, battle dangerous creatures, rescue survivors, and rebuild the ruined town of Emberville while uncovering the truth behind this prison.
2295170.name: Emberville

2300320.desc: Farming Simulator 25 invites you to join the rewarding farm life, single-handedly or cooperatively in multiplayer. This Farm is Your Farm!
2300320.name: Farming Simulator 25

230410.desc: Awaken as an unstoppable warrior and battle alongside your friends in this story-driven free-to-play online action game
230410.name: Warframe

2310.desc: Developed by the award-winning id Software, Quake® is the ground-breaking, original dark fantasy first-person shooter that inspires today’s retro-style FPS games. With Quake (Enhanced), experience the authentic, updated, and visually enhanced version of the original.
2310.name: Quake

2318330.desc: After quitting her dead-end job, Fiona starts over on a farm and becomes the immortal herald of a dead god. Make friends, fight through horrors and pay your debt in this nightmarish life sim RPG.
2318330.name: Neverway

2319360.desc: A colorful puzzle adventure about a lost child searching for her memories, guiding her through darkness by mastering light and shadow.
2319360.name: Memento Dawn

2321960.desc: From the makers of Cozy Grove: Glide through pastel clouds, help lost spirits along the way, and design your own home nestled high on a mountain peak. Befriend strangers around a warm campfire, or share memories while lazily fishing in the sky with a friend. Welcome to your strange new home. 🏠🏔️
2321960.name: Spirit Crossing

2340970.desc: Railborn is a survival game where you build your train piece by piece. Navigate a world entangled by branching tracks. Find rare plants to cultivate on your farms. Upgrade your train - manage its power systems, direct resource flow, and distribute water. Designed for 1 to 4 players.
2340970.name: Railborn

2357570.desc: Overwatch®, A FUTURE WORTH FIGHTING FOR! Overwatch® is an always-on and ever-evolving free-to-play, team-based action game set in an optimistic future, where every match is the ultimate 5v5 or 6v6 battlefield brawl.
2357570.name: Overwatch®

2358720.desc: Black Myth: Wukong is an action RPG rooted in Chinese mythology. You shall set out as the Destined One to venture into the challenges and marvels ahead, to uncover the obscured truth beneath the veil of a glorious legend from the past.
2358720.name: Black Myth: Wukong

236390.desc: War Thunder is the most comprehensive free-to-play, cross-platform, MMO military game dedicated to aviation, armoured vehicles, and naval craft, from the early 20th century to the most advanced modern combat units. Join now and take part in major battles on land, in the air, and at sea.
236390.name: War Thunder

2378230.desc: Sinister tides are rising in the Drowned City. Dive into a Point and Click action-RPG with fast-paced shoot-outs and retro arcade racing. Uncover the truth behind a murder you don't remember committing!
2378230.name: Neo Junk City

2379780.desc: The poker roguelike. Balatro is a hypnotically satisfying deckbuilder where you play illegal poker hands, discover game-changing jokers, and trigger adrenaline-pumping, outrageous combos.
2379780.name: Balatro

2381520.desc: Unrecord is a single-player FPS that tells the story of a tactical police officer from the perspective of his body camera. As you work to solve a complex case, you'll need to use your tactical and detective skills to succeed.
2381520.name: Unrecord

2384980.desc: Build and manage your cafe business. Customize your shop with furniture and decorations, brew various beverages, serve customers efficiently, expand your space, and compete with rival cafés. Grow from a small shop to a thriving empire. Oh, and there's chicken wrestling too.
2384980.name: Cafe Simulator

238960.desc: You are an Exile, struggling to survive on the dark continent of Wraeclast, as you fight to earn power that will allow you to exact your revenge against those who wronged you. Path of Exile is an online Action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. The game is completely free and will never be pay-to-win.
238960.name: Path of Exile

239140.desc: First-person action survival game set in a post-apocalyptic open world overrun by flesh-hungry zombies. Roam a city devastated by a mysterious virus epidemic. Scavenge for supplies, craft weapons, and face hordes of the infected.
239140.name: Dying Light

2396130.desc: Deploy and merge units into 1,500+ variations to defend your train in tight Turn-Based Strategy battles, then see if your build survives Autobattler journeys between stations against massive monster hordes. Build you crew. Defend the train. Deliver the cargo.
2396130.name: Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business

2399830.desc: ARK is reimagined from the ground-up into the next-generation of video game technology with Unreal Engine 5! Form a tribe, tame & breed hundreds of unique dinosaurs and primeval creatures, explore, craft, build, and fight your way to the top of the food-chain. Your new world awaits!
2399830.name: ARK: Survival Ascended

240.desc: Counter-Strike: Source blends Counter-Strike's award-winning teamplay action with the advanced technology of Source™ technology.
240.name: Counter-Strike: Source

2400.desc: The Ship is a murder mystery multiplayer.
2400.name: The Ship: Murder Party

24010.desc: The ultimate railway hobby for more than 15 years! From historic steam locomotives to modern high-speed and heavy freight trains, and routes around the world, Train Simulator Classic is the simulation made by railfans for railfans.
24010.name: Train Simulator Classic

2406770.desc: Bodycam is the first tactical multiplayer FPS with a true body-camera view in Unreal Engine 5. Close-quarters combats feel raw and loud. Every angle, callout, and bullet matters. Play Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, and Wingman on photoreal maps where teamplay, tactics, and clutch skill are key.
2406770.name: Bodycam

2408840.desc: A first-person alchemy roguelite. Wake in a dark lord's cell. Refine pills as tribute to survive. Handle pills, add ingredients, use fire. Success, damage or ruin: decide when to stop. Combine relics, catalysts and fire seeds to bend the odds. Face new trials daily. Will you live to escape?
2408840.name: Alchedoom

2418490.desc: In the merciless sands of the arena, a gladiator is forced to fight for survival. Trakonius defies Mars, the God of War, in this Action Roguelike experience! Face gladiators, mythological creatures, and deadly challenges across four brutal arenas. The truth can only be revealed through combat!
2418490.name: Trakonius

24200.desc: DC Universe Online is a Free-to-Play, massive multiplayer online action game set in the popular DC Universe. Become one of a new breed of Heroes or Villains and wield incredible powers as you go to war with legendary characters such as Batman, Superman, Lex Luthor and The Joker.
24200.name: DC Universe™ Online

24240.desc: Take on the role of a hardened career criminal executing intense, dynamic heists in constant pursuit of the next “big score”
24240.name: PAYDAY™ The Heist

242760.desc: As the lone survivor of a passenger jet crash, you find yourself in a mysterious forest battling to stay alive against a society of cannibalistic mutants. Build, explore, survive in this terrifying first person survival horror simulator.
242760.name: The Forest

2437330.desc: A combo-based deckbuilding roguelike through a space-time loop: collect cards, receive blessings, add pets to your party, and grow stronger. Chain together cards in the right order for max power, and act before the enemy does. Build synergistic decks, find many secrets, and make BIG numbers!
2437330.name: Novus Orbis

2437390.desc: Session based survival where players upgrade and live aboard their own personal trains. Team up with friends, make new ones or go solo. Board colossal Titan Trains to fight, build, craft, gather and steal much needed resources. Fortify and stock your personal train fortress. Will you survive?
2437390.name: Enginefall

2439280.desc: CHANGE THE PAST. CONTROL THE FUTURE. Alter the course of history and rewrite the future in this steampunk first-person RPG.
2439280.name: Clockwork Revolution

2439500.desc: Overhours is a single-player action tower defense game set in a fictional agency facing an invasion of soul-eating monsters. Work the night owl shift and face the hordes with a variety of traps and special abilities!
2439500.name: Overhours

244210.desc: Assetto Corsa v1.16 introduces the new "Laguna Seca" laser-scanned track, 7 new cars among which the eagerly awaited Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio! Check the changelog for further info!
244210.name: Assetto Corsa

2450350.desc: Prepare for goblin-packed, hat-stealing, and princess-fattening team based 16v16 combat! Siege the castle walls, rescue your pudgy princess, fatten up the enemy princess with delicious meat, unlock new hats & classes, and kill each other repeatedly in silly and chaotic PvP war!
2450350.name: Fat Goblins

2454980.desc: Drakantos is a free-to-play MMORPG with a nostalgic pixel art style, combined with exciting action combat and more than 20 unique playable heroes.
2454980.name: Drakantos

2483190.desc: Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Japan in over 550 real-world cars and become a racing Legend in Forza Horizon's biggest open world driving adventure yet.
2483190.name: Forza Horizon 6

2483570.name: Castillon

2483700.desc: HARMA is a retro dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilding game featuring a story-driven campaign. Uncover the truth behind the fallen knights, the burning kingdom, and your missing father. Harness the power of mighty artifacts to defeat demons and save a world on the brink of destruction.
2483700.name: HARMA

2486910.desc: Imagine an alien Sudoku where the numbers are elements. Figure out which element to place on the grid, where, and when!? In order to maintain balance, each element must harmonize with the others. “Aliens don't play Sudoku—they play COSMIC HOLES!” For adults and children.
2486910.name: COSMIC HOLES Junior

2487190.desc: Main Sequence is a first-person space-sim factory builder where you design spaceships, build space stations, and automate everything. Start with a single ship and grow to become an interstellar industrial empire as you leave your mark on the galaxy.
2487190.name: Main Sequence

2498890.desc: Inspired by early 2010s rage games, BOOM! Buster bursts through the arcade genre with a fresh, new experience in this unrelenting hot-potato platformer.
2498890.name: BOOM! Buster

2507950.desc: Play for free in operator-based extraction and full-scale combined arms warfare. Become elite Operators, customize an ever-expanding arsenal of weapons, and deploy into thrill-packed missions across multiple modes.
2507950.name: Delta Force

2508290.desc: Hunt down tax-evading billionaires and rebuild society in a hand-drawn, action-roguelite platformer inspired by 90's comicbooks.
2508290.name: Tax-Force

250900.desc: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth is a randomly generated action RPG shooter with heavy Rogue-like elements. Following Isaac on his journey players will find bizarre treasures that change Isaac’s form giving him super human abilities and enabling him to fight off droves of mysterious creatures, discover secrets and fight his way to safety.
250900.name: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth

251570.desc: 7 Days to Die is an open-world game that is a unique combination of first-person shooter, survival horror, tower defense, and role-playing games. Play the definitive zombie survival sandbox RPG that came first. Navezgane awaits!
251570.name: 7 Days to Die

2523740.desc: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered: The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics.
2523740.name: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered

252490.desc: The only aim in Rust is to survive. Everything wants you to die - the island’s wildlife, other inhabitants, the environment, and other survivors. Do whatever it takes to last another night.
252490.name: Rust

252950.desc: Rocket League is a high-powered hybrid of arcade-style soccer and vehicular mayhem with easy-to-understand controls and fluid, physics-driven competition. Rocket League includes casual and competitive Online Matches, a fully-featured offline Season Mode, special “Mutators” that let you change the rules entirely, hockey and...
252950.name: Rocket League®

2540670.desc: In the vibrant realm of Terralysia lurk relentless enemies. Brace yourself for grueling missions, endless onslaughts, and formidable bosses in this third-person roguelike. Use the right strategy and spells to survive a bit longer, but be warned, as you grow in strength, so do your enemies.
2540670.name: Terralysia

255710.desc: Cities: Skylines is a modern take on the classic city simulation. The game introduces new game play elements to realize the thrill and hardships of creating and maintaining a real city whilst expanding on some well-established tropes of the city building experience.
255710.name: Cities: Skylines

2561460.desc: Burning Sword: Death Sun is a wuxia action game set in 12th century China. Play as Zhang Yixiang, cast down by the Elder of the Northern Mountain, and carve a bloody path back to him. Hardcore combat, epic boss battles, roguelite progression, and an arena built for high scores.
2561460.name: Burning Sword: Death Sun

2582960.desc: NAKWON is a multiplayer zombie survival game set in urban South Korea. Venture into the city in the dead of night, and manage your shelter by day. Scavenge resources in a city crawling with the infected and hostile survivors. Survival is the only rule - trust no one, not even the living.
2582960.name: NAKWON: LAST PARADISE

2584270.desc: Their Flesh Is Your Weapon. Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel action-RPG with adrenaline-charged, high-stakes combat. Possess warrior Shells, dethrone false gods, redeem a ravaged world.
2584270.name: Mortal Shell II

2590.desc: Somewhere in deep space, at an apparently abandoned mining base on the asteriod Alpha Prime, something has gone terribly wrong. Miners were warned that the hubbardium they were mining was too dangerous, but the lure of unimaginable wealth was too strong.
2590.name: Alpha Prime

2590240.desc: METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.
2590240.name: METRO 2039

2600.desc: Vampire®: The Masquerade-Bloodlines™ delivers a new type of RPG experience-one that blends all the core elements of a traditional RPG with the graphical richness, immediacy and brutal combat of a first-person action game. The game plunges players into the dark and gritty vampire underworld of modern-day L.A. as a creature of the night.
2600.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines

2610770.desc: Dust Front is a classic RTS with grand strategy elements and a non-linear campaign. Lead strategic maneuvers, overwhelm your enemies with cannon fodder, or stomp them into the stone age with carpet bombing on the lifeless fields of Dust Front.
2610770.name: Dust Front RTS

261550.desc: A strategy/action RPG. Create a character, engage in diplomacy, craft, trade and conquer new lands in a vast medieval sandbox. Raise armies to lead into battle and command and fight alongside your troops in massive real-time battles using a deep but intuitive skill-based combat system.
261550.name: Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord

2622380.desc: ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN is a standalone adventure within the ELDEN RING universe, crafted to offer players a new gaming experience by reimagining the game’s core design.
2622380.name: ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN

2624080.desc: MycoRelic is a cooperative third person action-RPG set on islands inhabited by tribal mushroom robots. Loot derelict foundries to upgrade your robotic body. Explore ancient temples to infuse your fungus with forgotten elemental powers.
2624080.name: MycoRelic

2630.desc: Call of Duty® 2 redefines the cinematic intensity and chaos of battle as seen through the eyes of ordinary soldiers fighting together in epic WWII conflicts. The sequel to 2003's Call of Duty, winner of over 80 Game of the Year awards, Call of Duty 2 offers more immense, more intense, more realistic battles than ever before, thanks to...
2630.name: Call of Duty® 2

2638080.desc: A story-driven roguelite RPG about a journey through the depths with a broken hero — and what they have to answer for. The hero's party has been annihilated: you carry one of them out of a cursed dungeon, learn what broke them, and settle it together. Four routes, four heroes, four reckonings.
2638080.name: Annihilated

264710.desc: Descend into the depths of an alien underwater world filled with wonder and peril. Craft equipment, pilot submarines and out-smart wildlife to explore lush coral reefs, volcanoes, cave systems, and more - all while trying to survive.
264710.name: Subnautica

2649560.desc: The iconic RPG series returns! The highly anticipated next chapter delivers a bold, new standalone story blending heartfelt daily life and new characters with pulse-pounding, supernatural adventure. Whether it’s your first Persona game or you’ve been here since the beginning, this one’s for you.
2649560.name: Persona 6

266410.desc: We are the world’s premier motorsports racing game. An iRacing membership provides entry into the newest form of motorsport: internet racing. Internet racing is a fun, easy, and inexpensive way for race fan and gamers alike to enjoy the thrill of the racetrack from the comfort of their home.
266410.name: iRacing

2669450.desc: My Child New Beginnings is a parenting simulator where you go through everyday life of growth. After a series of traumatic events that you and your child went through, you now get to rebuild life together in a new region of Norway.
2669450.name: My Child New Beginnings

2670430.desc: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure is a pixel-art precision platformer. Fire your floating cannon to trigger switches and move platforms. Grab items to dash with varying charges, directions and distances. Chart a path underground, restart power stations, and uncover the AI Deus's secrets.
2670430.name: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure

2679670.desc: Fix stick drift and calibrate your controller on Windows. Health Score, guided Quick Fix, and Save to console - write centre and range to your pad over USB, then unplug and play on PlayStation, Xbox, or Nintendo.

2692660.desc: Build, repair, and grow your automotive empire — now also in co-op mode! Run a workshop together, fix cars, and expand your collection. Hundreds of configurations, thousands of parts, and full customization await!
2692660.name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2027

2694490.desc: Path of Exile 2 is a next generation Action RPG from Grinding Gear Games, featuring co-op for up to six players. Set years after the original Path of Exile, you will return to the dark world of Wraeclast and seek to end the corruption that is spreading.

271590.name: Grand Theft Auto V Legacy

2718320.desc: Make the planet Green Again in this relaxing colony sim game! Help a nation of little plant people reclaim their planet taken over by defective robots, as you build, decorate, and defend your settlement. Grow crops for your citizens, explore the unknown, and protect the new natural order!
2718320.name: Green Again

2719590.desc: A game about adventure, building, survival and exploration together. Set on a fantasy planet the size of Earth.

2735560.desc: A roguelike survival sim where you rule your bridge as a cunning or ravenous troll. Eat, toll, and spare travelers to balance hunger, greed, and favor as you choose whether to become a feared predator… or a worshiped guardian of the bridge.

Between artistic ambitions, romance, family mysteries and the call of the occult, the ways toward your destiny are multiple and tortuous. Lena, Magdalena ou Madeleine… Who will you be when the curtain falls?

275390.desc: The definitive version of the smash-hit Metroidvania-style action-platformer, Guacamelee! STCE adds new levels, powers, challenges, and refinements to the sprawling, ridiculous, Mexican-inspired adventure of the original Guacamelee! Gold Edition.
275390.name: Guacamelee! Super Turbo Championship Edition

2807960.desc: The ultimate all-out warfare experience. In a war of tanks, fighter jets, and massive combat arsenals, your squad is the deadliest weapon.

2847780.desc: Ignite your sword and explore the dark depths and towering heights of a forgotten island that consumed itself long ago.

2944770.name: A Snail's Tale

Missions are based on key historical operations.

300.desc: Valve's WWII Multiplayer Classic - Now available for Mac.

Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

322170.desc: Jump and fly your way through danger in this rhythm-based action platformer!

3292470.name: Tides of Annihilation

3305190.desc: Feed your fellow Shape Buddies to a bizarre cast of Glutton Monsters before they put you on the menu. Catch, balance and fling food with absurd, anything-but-proper plates — solo, or 2 players on one PC or via Steam Remote Play Together. Everything obeys physics; nothing obeys you.
3305190.name: One More Plate!

3319680.desc: A blend of classic turn-based roguelike dungeon crawling with the intensity of modern survivors games. Set the pace with every step as you unlock multiple dungeons and blast through swarms of enemies! Gather loot, customize your build, and learn to survive.. the Delve!
3319680.name: Delve Survivors

3320.desc: The craziest aquarium game ever! Tend to your fish, keep them happy and they'll reward you with coins and jewels. Buy tank upgrades or egg parts which hatch different in-tank pets. These pets can help you feed your fish, collect coins, or even protect against the aliens that will invade your tank.
3320.name: Insaniquarium Deluxe

3321460.desc: Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure set on the continent of Pywel. Join Kliff on his journey to rebuild the Greymane faction and to save the land from a looming threat. From vast wilderness and cities to ruins and the mysterious Abyss, forge your path through battles and discovery.
3321460.name: Crimson Desert Enhanced

33230.desc: An epic story of family, vengeance and conspiracy set in the pristine, yet brutal, backdrop of a Renaissance Italy. New low price!
33230.name: Assassin's Creed 2

3330.desc: Deep in the jungle lie hidden temples bursting with traps and trickery, and it's up to you to uncover their treasures. Fire magical balls from your stone frog idol to make matches of three or more and clear the deadly chain before it reaches the golden skull.
3330.name: Zuma Deluxe

3337850.desc: Delve into KYORA, a mystical multiplayer sandbox adventure, where every pixel is yours to shape, mine, build or explode.
3337850.name: KYORA

3366370.desc: Explore, fight, and SMUSH in this hand-drawn roguelite first person adventure! Descend a magical bunker filled with wild biomes, master magical tools, manage your fear gauge, overcome hazards, combat spooky enemies, and cause co-op chaos.
3366370.name: UnderMire

3371050.desc: Welcome to Zeverland, survive & craft together with your friends in a deceptively cute apocalypse, with no limits! Everything is interactive like the real world—dismantle toilets, strap zombie heads to bats, or weld a bed to your RV. Then, try to repair bridges, make vaccines, and relight the world!
3371050.name: Zeverland

3376710.desc: Hunt raccoons and feed them to your pet.
3376710.name: Raccoon Hunter

33930.desc: Three years after the conflict in Chernarus, portrayed in the original Arma 2, a new flashpoint explodes in the Green Sea Region. Coalition forces led by the US Army are deployed to Takistan to quickly restore peace and prevent further civilian casualties.
33930.name: Arma 2: Operation Arrowhead

3393110.desc: AION 2 is the only MMORPG built around a world where the sky is the battlefield. Choose your faction, ascend as a Daeva, and fight a faction war across a world 36 times larger than the original. PC only, on Unreal Engine 5.
3393110.name: AION 2

340.desc: Originally planned as a section of the Highway 17 chapter of Half-Life 2, Lost Coast is a playable technology showcase that introduces High Dynamic Range lighting to the Source engine.
340.name: Half-Life 2: Lost Coast

34030.desc: Complete your Total War collection with this Definitive Edition of Total War: NAPOLEON, which includes all DLC and feature updates since the game’s release
34030.name: Total War: NAPOLEON – Definitive Edition

3404030.desc: CLOGWORK is a factory automation game. Cut, glue and rotate pieces into the shapes you need. Build conveyor belts and logic circuits, prevent jams, and deliver finished shapes to the Hub. Build in 2D, or switch to 3D at any time.
3404030.name: Clogwork

3405690.desc: Experience The World's Game like never before in EA SPORTS FC™ 26. Go for glory in a 48-team international tournament mode, take on themed Manager Live Challenges, and step into Player Career with new international ICONs and Heroes.
3405690.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 26

3419430.desc: Bongo cat needs your help. Bongo cat needz more hatz!!! Every time you press a key, Bongo cat will punch your taskbar. Type, click, play, work to collect more points. Which hats will you find?
3419430.name: Bongo Cat

3433110.desc: Tycoon game where you manage your movie theater through more than 100 years of history. Build and customize your cinematic empire without being overtaken by the evolution of the 7th art.
3433110.name: Cinema Theater Tycoon

3435580.desc: Noir Total is a 2D local multiplayer PvP shooter set in darkened arenas. Sneak through total darkness using your controller’s vibrations, track down your enemies, collect bonuses and set traps to stay one step ahead of your opponents in fast-paced, competitive matches for up to 4 players.
3435580.name: Noir Total : Deadly Party

3454650.desc: Join thousands of players in a true sandbox MMORPG where every action shapes a living, player-driven world. Master long-term professions at your own pace, unlock mounts and boats, and grow your settlement into a cozy homestead or thriving metropolis. Grind solo, build together, or play passively.
3454650.name: BitCraft Online

346110.desc: Stranded on the shores of a mysterious island, you must learn to survive. Use your cunning to kill or tame the primeval creatures roaming the land, and encounter other players to survive, dominate... and escape!
346110.name: ARK: Survival Evolved

3475680.desc: You drive left. They drive right. Straight? Only if you're both on the same page. Shared RC splits control of one car between two players — team up (or don't) across brutal, physics-based courses where every wrong move is somebody else's fault too.
3475680.name: Shared RC

3480.desc: Take your best shot with energizing arcade fun! Aim, shoot, clear the orange pegs, then sit back and cheer as 10 whimsical teachers guide you to Peggle greatness.
3480.name: Peggle Deluxe

3483.desc: Peggle Extreme delivers fast-paced puzzle action that combines elements of pinball and pachinko to create a truly unique game experience. Take your best shot with energizing arcade fun, now exclusively themed with art and sounds from Half-Life: Episode 2, Portal, and Team Fortress 2.
3483.name: Peggle Extreme

34870.desc: Sniper: Ghost Warrior 2 takes the bulls-eye precision of its predecessor to new and exciting heights!
34870.name: Sniper: Ghost Warrior 2

34900.desc: Bad Rats is a physics puzzle game where rats finally get their bloody revenge on their new prisoners: The cats. Come up with creative solutions for each puzzle using physics, functional objects, and your specially trained Rats. Try different ways of solving each puzzle to finish faster or earn higher scores.
34900.name: Bad Rats: the Rats' Revenge

3499790.desc: In this massive RTS game, command vast armies fighting for control of entire worlds. Control the forces of Earth, the mechanical AI Substrate, or the enigmatic Post-Human Coalition as you battle across the solar system in single player, cooperative multiplayer, or competitive multiplayer.
3499790.name: Ashes of the Singularity II

3504050.desc: A disappearance in a secluded community. A mountain hiding its secrets. A detective running out of time. Welcome to Hillthorn, a dark investigation game that invites you to uncover the mystery without a single word spoken, using your skills of logic and intuition through cards.
3504050.name: Hillthorn

3509080.desc: Forged: Reconquest is a couch & online co-op blacksmithing RTS for up to 4 players sets in medieval era. Team up as master smiths to forge magical gear, arm your armies, and wage war against otherworldly foes in a battle to reclaim your world.
3509080.name: Forged: Reconquest

3513350.desc: Wuthering Waves is a story-rich open-world action RPG with a high degree of freedom. You wake from your slumber as Rover, joined by a vibrant cast of Resonators on a journey to reclaim your lost memories and change the world.
3513350.name: Wuthering Waves

3517740.desc: Through the frost, death follows the tracks. Dive into a ruthless survival FPS, solo or co-op. Explore, scavenge, craft and fight to endure a frozen, corrupted world. Operate and upgrade your steam-powered train through an unforgiving wasteland, where every choice is a matter of survival.
3517740.name: Frostrail

3527290.desc: PEAK is a co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. Either solo or as a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its center. Do you have what it takes to reach the PEAK?
3527290.name: PEAK

3540610.desc: A top-down action roguelite where you capture pets and battle alien hordes. Choose your weapons and combine upgrades and items to create your own combat style. Capture alien creatures to use their abilities or bring them to your base for materials. Recruit new characters and conquer the planet!
3540610.name: Astral Hunter: Homebound

3549030.desc: Explore dungeons in a single-player, turn-based RPG. Learn skills across classes, craft gear with your choice of materials, and lead a party of up to five against bosses. Develop your village and build bonds with your companions.
3549030.name: Heavensmith: Dungeon Unbound

3551820.desc: Fight hordes of evil monsters and defend your castle in this 1-4 player action platformer with Roguelike elements!
3551820.name: Castlebound

3555210.desc: Beekeeper Simulator puts you in the shoes of a dedicated beekeeper, where you'll care for buzzing hives, harvest a variety of honey types, and expand your operations to build a thriving beekeeping empire. Nurture your bees, optimize your apiary, and turn your passion into profit!
3555210.name: Beekeeper Simulator

3558670.desc: Experience a stunning reimagining of Lara Croft’s debut adventure to discover the lost secrets of Atlantis with jaw-dropping visuals, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.
3558670.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis

3570680.desc: Meltdown is a nuclear reactor desk-job simulation where you, as a newly recruited operator, must control the reactor to keep the surrounding city powered up. Maintain the wires in the power grid, regulate the water tank’s flow, and tune the steam ventilation to keep the reactor from overheating.
3570680.name: Meltdown

3590.desc: Zombies are invading your home, and the only defense is your arsenal of plants! Armed with an alien nursery-worth of zombie-zapping plants like peashooters and cherry bombs, you'll need to think fast and plant faster to stop dozens of types of zombies dead in their tracks.
3590.name: Plants vs. Zombies GOTY Edition

359550.desc: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege is an elite, tactical team-based shooter where superior planning and execution triumph.
359550.name: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege

360.desc: Half-Life Deathmatch: Source is a recreation of the first multiplayer game set in the Half-Life universe. Features all the classic weapons and most-played maps, now running on the Source engine.
360.name: Half-Life Deathmatch: Source

3607230.desc: RIDICULOUS SPACE BATTLES is the spiritual successor to the first ever autobattler game: Gratuitous Space Battles! After a fifteen year wait, the ridiculously over-the-top and completely unjustified battles in space ARE BACK.
3607230.name: Ridiculous Space Battles

3610790.desc: 17-year-old Hope Song thought the national exams were her biggest worry... until she got home to a ransacked apartment and two missing parents. Investigate through the eyes of an artist, turn sketches into evidence, and watch her family's mystery grow stranger and darker with every answer.
3610790.name: Hope in the City

3618480.desc: Follow in the footsteps of a missing Egyptologist as you explore mysterious passageways beneath the Great Pyramids. Solve 50 unique and challenging puzzles, uncover ancient artifacts, and discover the truth behind his disappearance.
3618480.name: Journey Under The Pyramids

3629430.desc: DREADMOOR is a dark first-person fishing adventure game set in a submerged world, rotting from a past catastrophe. Fish in murky waters, upgrade your boat, craft survival gear, and fight monstrous creatures that lurk under the water and on the land.
3629430.name: DREADMOOR

3634320.desc: Build, customize, and unleash your ultimate space platform in NebulArena, a fast-paced, fully automated PvP arena where strategy, design, and destruction collide!
3634320.name: NebulArena

3642910.desc: Embark on bite-sized campaigns in this co-op action RPG set in a rustic fantasy world. Start from nothing, and freely build your character as you investigate rumors, explore strange ruins, and survive the dangers threatening the fallen Kingdom of Caerwyn.
3642910.name: Wyldheart

3646950.desc: Ghost Hunting Journal is an anime-style narrative adventure game. Follow a duo of self-proclaimed “Spirit Agents” as they take on supernatural cases, use a range of ghost-hunting techniques, and investigate urban legends surrounding the lingering spirits of Riverrun.
3646950.name: Ghost Hunting Journal

3652920.desc: Netherwake is a story-driven first-person psychological horror game. Explore a town consumed by unnatural fog and a facility beneath the mountain. Hide from deadly anomalies, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover what happened before they find you.
3652920.name: Netherwake

365670.desc: Blender is the free and open source 3D creation suite. Free to use for everyone, for any purpose.
365670.name: Blender

3657320.desc: Defend fallen stars from an onslaught of shadow creatures, strategize with unique animal towers, and upgrade your lighthouse community as you adventure through the changing seasons to uncover the memories of fallen stars.
3657320.name: Pelikeeper: A TD Adventure

3669200.desc: A PvE roguelike autobattler with no timers, no queue and no PvP. Draft a guild, rank heroes from C to S and stack 300+ relics into builds that one-shot bosses. Climb 8 difficulties and the Endless leaderboards. Start small, become unstoppable.
3669200.name: Guildrun

3669620.desc: Warhammer Survivors is the official grim and dark bullet-heaven game from the developers of Warhammer 40,000 Boltgun. Play as over 40 iconic champions from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes and obliterate those who champion death and destruction.
3669620.name: Warhammer Survivors

367520.desc: Forge your own path in Hollow Knight! An epic action adventure through a vast ruined kingdom of insects and heroes. Explore twisting caverns, battle tainted creatures and befriend bizarre bugs, all in a classic, hand-drawn 2D style.
367520.name: Hollow Knight

3677850.desc: Explore a mysterious hot springs in the dead of night and meet the other lost souls who are drawn to this place.
3677850.name: Springs, Eternal

3678970.desc: The ultimate tiny idle RPG! Adorable pixel heroes are waiting to join your adventure — from your taskbar. Fight off the boredom of work and daily life with diverse classes, skills, items, and builds!
3678970.name: TBH: Task Bar Hero

3680170.desc: A round-based co-op zombies FPS for 1 to 4 players. Survive endless hordes in brutalist procedurally generated map. Buy doors, hit the mystery box, upgrade your guns, and uncover the hidden ritual that wakes the Mother.
3680170.name: Mortuus

3681220.desc: The shadow wants to play with you. It moves quickly, and you have to find it. Be patient, but don't wait too long. Light will be your friend. Don't make the shadow angry.
3681220.name: The Light Switch

3687090.desc: Dice Hoarder is a cozy organizing game where you restock a mysterious dice shop. Sort every die in the shop, match them into complete seven-piece sets, and uncover what is hidden behind your new job.
3687090.name: Dice Hoarder

3692020.desc: Exodus Core is a hard turn-based tactical game with a dark sci-fi apocalyptic atmosphere. Take control of three massive mechs with the digitized personalities of soldiers and face a Swarm of thinking monsters from the dark. Can you win a hopeless battle?
3692020.name: Exodus Core

3699850.desc: You lost your soul in a poker game against the Devil. Now, trapped in the infernal depths, your only hope is to fight your way back to freedom. You’ll face a diverse gallery of monstrous foes in nearly impossible poker battles - but luckily, you’re a cheater.
3699850.name: The Devil's Due

3700360.desc: Betrayed, broke, and packing twin magic hand cannons, ex-noble Alice is fighting to survive with her one-armed butler in a ruthless world where the strong rule the weak. A dark fantasy JRPG with full voice acting, nostalgic doujin-style visuals, and 20+ hours of story-driven adventure.
3700360.name: Princessfall

3709320.desc: Coffee Buns is a transformation visual novel set in the world of Mice Tea. Leonardo Bianco is a barista getting used to living in a world where a magical tea can turn you into a furry, and when he gets his own chance to try it he's thrust into an erotic, gender-bending journey of self-discovery.
3709320.name: Coffee Buns

3710120.desc: Brew potions, compete with fellow alchemists, and save the magical world from destruction in the digital adaptation of the beloved board game.
3710120.name: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist

3710600.desc: Become an acolyte of the Inquisition in this grim dark, party-based, story-driven cRPG. Lead investigations, uncover grand conspiracies, master tactical combat, and wage a secret war against heresy. Make tough choices as a conduit of the God-Emperor’s will.
3710600.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy

3714800.desc: Play as Kaatri in Warlock, a single-player, third-person action-adventure set in a D&D-inspired open world. Wield forbidden magic to bend the rules around you. Across exploration and combat, every challenge is a test of creativity, preparation, and cunning.
3714800.name: Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons

3721530.desc: Buy rusty motorcycles, restore every part, add custom paint and decals, then take them for a test ride and sell them for a profit. Turn barn finds into superbikes and grow your small garage into the best dealership in town.
3721530.name: Motorcycle For Sale Simulator

3722820.desc: A lightning strike, a torch in your hands, and a voice echoes: “Your fates are now bound.” Tied together by a fragile rope — if it snaps, the fall is inevitable. Jump, climb, solve, slide… but never lose your rhythm. Only the patient will glimpse the summit.
3722820.name: Onlympic Up!

3724300.desc: Toto’s Journey is a cozy adventure inspired by the world of The Wizard of Oz. Play as Toto, a brave dog lost in a magical world after a mysterious cyclone. Explore enchanted lands, meet unusual creatures, and solve environmental puzzles as you search for a way back home.
3724300.name: Toto's Journey

3727390.desc: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in The Expanse universe. You’re no hero — just a merc caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to hold your crew together and keep the ship up and running. Your choices will shape your story.
3727390.name: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn

3737610.desc: Rocket-jump using exploding fireballs, unlock abilities and master an ever-growing movement system. Explore the non-linear corners of the underworld, find secrets, defeat demons and reclaim the Eye of Evil.
3737610.name: Explosiovania

3739580.desc: Fight off hordes of demons in this unforgiving gates shooter! Slay monsters, pick up upgrades, and create overpowered builds to annihilate bosses while listening to heavy metal tracks. Many foes and secrets await you in the catacombs...
3739580.name: KORRIDOR

3751490.desc: Investigating his grandmother's mysterious death, a detective enters her home in search of the truth. But the house begins to toy with him. Space twists, fears take shape, and there's no way out. Every step, every room, every loop brings him closer to madness.
3751490.name: Sitter

3759000.desc: A casual, water-physics puzzle game about building dams as a beaver (2 - 3 hours). Gnaw down trees, and grab and throw objects to organically build dams, back up water, and progress to the next level.
3759000.name: Beaver Creek

3763040.desc: Mellings are striking back! Control an excavator and grab resources to bring them back to the burrow, defend yourself with various cannons while harvesting, and destroy huge buildings and bosses!
3763040.name: Mellings

3769420.desc: Zombie wave survival meets King of the hill. Survive, Upgrade, and Protect your flag. Face the unexpected through special rounds, endure the constantly growing horde, and customize your loadout. How many rounds will you survive?
3769420.name: Hill-Z

377160.desc: From Bethesda Game Studios, the award-winning creators of Starfield and The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, comes Fallout 4. A landmark in open-world RPG design and winner of over 200 ‘Best Of’ honors, including the DICE and BAFTA Game of the Year.
377160.name: Fallout 4

3788800.desc: The Atomic Heart sequel brings you back to the retrofuturistic universe, full of new characters and dangers. The game immerses you in events on a global scale and raises the bar for what an open-world action RPG can do.
3788800.name: Atomic Heart 2

3796990.desc: Explore the Land of Fire and Ice! Iceland stands apart as one of the most extraordinary countries on Earth, an incredibly unique landscape with completely unmatched rugged nature. Now, you have the chance to experience it all from a truly unique perspective - behind the wheel of your truck.
3796990.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - Iceland

3801210.desc: Defend a dying world and bring it back to life as you play. Grow spirit trees to defeat enemies, releasing energy that spreads across the land, restoring the forest in real time as you push back a world-consuming blight.
3801210.name: Rebirth TD

3809270.desc: Trade cargo for passengers in a whole new ETS2 journey! Take a seat behind the wheel – not of a truck, but of a coach. The Coaches DLC brings a new dimension to the ETS2 experience by introducing scheduled passenger transport across Europe.
3809270.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - Coaches

3810510.desc: DERELIKT is a narrative retro FPS built for fans of claustrophobic PS1-era sci-fi horror.
3810510.name: DERELIKT

3810960.desc: Like Pacman, but the roles are reversed! Command a squad of officers and corner the bad guys before they make off with their stash! Use your mouse and keyboard to order the officers to pinch the criminals before time runs out!
3810960.name: Sting Operation

381210.desc: 10 years of horror. 10 years of jump scares and close calls. 10 years of brutal sacrifices and thrilling escapes. Trapped forever in a realm of eldritch evil where even death is not an escape, four determined Survivors face a bloodthirsty Killer in a vicious game of nerve and wits.
381210.name: Dead by Daylight

3814550.desc: Hi, I’m Jessica, and welcome to Brothel Hotel! This pixel art management game for adults puts you in charge of an exclusive brothel. Your mission? Oversee every aspect of the business, ensure smooth operations, and fulfill the desires of an ever-demanding clientele.
3814550.name: Brothel Hotel

3816120.desc: Interactive movie‑game blending SLG gameplay and real‑life romance simulation: Step into the shoes of an underdog and live out a power‑fantasy rags‑to‑riches story. Combat, character progression, drinking and romance — all in one! 100‑GB content volume- redefines your power‑fantasy experience!
3816120.name: Re2 I Rise Alone

3830.desc: A Psychic Odyssey Through the Minds of Misfits, Monsters, and Madmen. This classic action/adventure platformer from acclaimed developers Double Fine Productions follows the story of a young psychic named Razputin.
3830.name: Psychonauts

3830080.desc: Embark on a Dark Fantasy odyssey in Twilight Requiem, an action RPG blending heart-pounding combat and mystical exploration. Wield cosmic powers, master fluid combos inspired by Kingdom Hearts 2 Final Mix, and traverse haunting realms through enigmatic portals.
3830080.name: Twilight Requiem

3850230.desc: A fast-paced co-op zombie survival action game where players fight through hordes of enemies, unlock random power-ups, build different synergies, and escape together as a team.
3850230.name: 99Day Survival Guide

3856990.desc: A roguelike strategy game inside a slot machine. Pick your Companions, set the order they fire in, change your symbols with Gems, and build an engine that keeps growing, until the machine is wonderfully broken and the bosses can’t keep up. No real-money gambling.
3856990.name: Spin Tactics

386360.desc: Join 40+ million players in SMITE, the Battleground of the Gods! Wield Thor’s hammer, turn your foes to stone as Medusa, or flex your divine power as one of 100+ other mythological icons. Become a God and play FREE today!
386360.name: SMITE®

3864580.desc: P.O.N. is a co-op superhero horror game where you're just another low-level thug in the criminal underworld. Justice never sleeps. Stick together, watch each other's backs, or be trapped here forever. It's already here. Don't let it find you.
3864580.name: P.O.N.

3891660.desc: The House Dreams Along With Them is a first person puzzle adventure with an emphasis on interactivity and logic. Sleep and dream in the rooms of a mysterious house. Solve the puzzles to make the dreams real and take a step towards the enigmatic reification of night.
3891660.name: The House Dreams Along With Them

3908970.desc: Mine every Shit Coin in the world.
3908970.name: Shit Coin Miner

3912630.desc: Triggerhold is a first-person zombie tower-defense + voxel base-builder. Pick from 12 classes, fortify against endless escalating waves and brutal bosses, tame the undead to fight for you, and hold the line.
3912630.name: Triggerhold

3917850.desc: A realistic referee simulator! Show cards, use VAR, control matches, and rise through your referee career!
3917850.name: Football Referee Life Simulator 26

3932890.desc: Escape from Tarkov is the original extraction FPS where every raid is a gamble with death. Prep your raid, bleed, endure and fight through ruthless PMC players and Scavs, gain tactical advantage and cling to your loot — only extraction decides if you live or lose it all.
3932890.name: Escape from Tarkov

3936340.desc: HELL WAIT is riichi mahjong crossed with roguelike deckbuilding. Stack your jokers. Upgrade your yaku. Try not to deal in. You'll need those fingers.
3936340.name: Hell Wait

3940120.desc: Fight your way through unrelenting waves of enemies in this top-down roguelite deckbuilding bullet heaven. Build and upgrade your deck with powerful weapons and perks to survive the gauntlet, defeat the bosses, and escape!
3940120.name: Kevin's In Trouble

3941350.desc: Mine blocks across the screen, gather resources, and upgrade your tools. Build furnaces and automation systems to improve efficiency, then trigger chain reactions with special blocks to clear huge sections of the screen at once.
3941350.name: Mine It All!

394360.desc: Victory is at your fingertips! Your ability to lead your nation is your supreme weapon, the strategy game Hearts of Iron IV lets you take command of any nation in World War II; the most engaging conflict in world history.
394360.name: Hearts of Iron IV

3944590.desc: A heartfelt New Year’s story about relocation and growing up. From wrapping gifts to navigating bureaucracy, can you adjust to a new life and discover what home means to you now?
3944590.name: Relocat

3946460.desc: Design a beautiful cozy theme park or water park filled with rides, slides, decorations, and charm. Attract lovable Shroomies who wander around and bring your creation to life. A calm, cozy game about creativity and building your perfect little getaway.
3946460.name: Shroomy Garden

3946960.desc: Voody Hex is a roguelite plateformer. Enter into a voodoo cabaret and curse yourself to increase difficulty. You cannot attack - You need to survive.
3946960.name: Voody Hex

3957770.desc: A co-op cooking game where small mistakes quickly turn into chaos. Go shopping, cook in your food truck, and drive through the city to deliver orders on time.
3957770.name: Hot Meals Fast Wheels

3962650.desc: Cozy puzzle and arcade games to play your way: in a little window that stays on top while you work, on Steam Deck, or on the couch with a controller. Untangle arrows, pour sand, sort hex stacks or squish jelly, one bite-sized round at a time.
3962650.name: Pixel Pegz

3967580.desc: Hexograph is a hexagonal twist on nonogram puzzles. Use logic to solve handcrafted multi-color grids, read clues across three directions, untangle special hint rules, and reveal colorful hidden pictures.
3967580.name: Hexograph

3967860.desc: Strike with precision, time your deflects and fight flawlessly to your own rhythm. Step into atmospheric PvP or PvE arena duels and fast-paced clashes with a variety of lethal characters. Featuring GGPO-style rollback netcode for responsive online matches.
3967860.name: Rasen

3973040.desc: Chop, upgrade, repeat. Venture into a fast-regrowing forest in this top-down incremental roguelite. Draft cards to expand your level-up deck, recruit woodcutter friends, and scale your logging empire to harvest massive amounts of timber.
3973040.name: Treeternal

3975350.desc: Stack & Sus is a physics-based social deduction party game where 3-6 players stack one giant burger. The Staff work together to complete the dish, while hidden Spies try to topple it without blowing their cover. Was that placement really an accident? Team up, stack up, and find the Spy!
3975350.name: Stack & Sus

3976630.desc: Astrobarian™ is a 3D action RPG game where you and Cordina travel to different worlds — some cultivated, others filled with deadly hazards. Along the way, you may encounter others with different motives and unresolved mysteries.
3976630.name: Astrobarian™

3978820.desc: A horror-infused extraction shooter for squads of three. Crush monster hordes with devastating firepower in co-op PvE, or take on rival squads for The Vertex in PvP. Choose your battle, push as far as you dare, and make it out alive.
3978820.name: Rules of Engagement: The Grey State

3981890.desc: Try to get as high as possible before one of the blocks falls out of the construction zone.
3981890.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Unstable Towers

3994800.desc: An unknown signal. A silent ship. Only traces of the crew and empty corridors remain on the Sentinel. As Elara Wynn, you investigate what happened—and why the last transmission was a desperate distress call from the depths of space...
3994800.name: White Whisper

3997770.desc: Battle Runes of Metalaria is an action packed, chaos infused board game for up to four players. Stack your runes on the board to make vertical and horizontal combos or smash your opponents pieces to smithereens
3997770.name: Battle Runes of Metalaria

3999510.desc: "The Crowley blood stains the mansion's hallways, where voices whisper horrors that time tried to bury."
3999510.name: Siren's Well 2

40.desc: Enjoy fast-paced multiplayer gaming with Deathmatch Classic (a.k.a. DMC). Valve's tribute to the work of id software, DMC invites players to grab their rocket launchers and put their reflexes to the test in a collection of futuristic settings.
40.name: Deathmatch Classic

400.desc: Portal™ is a new single player game from Valve. Set in the mysterious Aperture Science Laboratories, Portal has been called one of the most innovative new games on the horizon and will offer gamers hours of unique gameplay.
400.name: Portal

4000.desc: Garry's Mod is a physics sandbox. There aren't any predefined aims or goals. We give you the tools and leave you to play.
4000.name: Garry's Mod

4001890.desc: A 1-4 player physics based fishing simulator. While drinking and boating you suddenly crash into a small island. To work your way back home you have to learn How to Fish.
4001890.name: How to Fish

4008250.desc: Risen Ballbylon is a transformative expansion for BALL x PIT, adding new levels, characters, balls, passives, enemies, bosses, and buildings, to the smash hit ball-bouncing roguelite. Will you rise to the challenge?
4008250.name: BALL x PIT: Risen Ballbylon

4009490.desc: Explore and survive in the Arctic, where your car is the only thing keeping you alive. Arctic Drive is a 1–4 player co-op survival sim set in a procedurally generated winter wilderness. Find supplies, repair your rig, and haul it all onwards with only one hope left: there must be safety out there.
4009490.name: Arctic Drive

4010820.desc: Eye of Darkness is a survivor game with a focus on exploration. You take on the role of a dark cultist on the path to awaken ancient evil - the Eye of Darkness. The forces of Light throw everything at you to stop you from plunging the world into eternal darkness.
4010820.name: Eye of Darkness

4018330.desc: Destroy the castle on the hill in this grim RPG where you play as the Dark Lord. Collect souls, summon an undead army, master dark abilities, craft powerful gear, build your base, and desecrate the lands of a vast open world.
4018330.name: Lord of Undead

4019220.desc: Become a dressmaker! Choose fabric, cut out pattern pieces and sew them all together to make the dresses of your dreams - in this cozy crafting game, inspired by real dressmaking.
4019220.name: Dressmaker

4031890.desc: Enjoy a farming life with mysterious creatures known as Pals! Team up with them to grow your farm at your own pace in this brand new creature-collecting farming sim, fully playable in multiplayer!
4031890.name: Palworld: Palfarm

4045480.desc: Draw your very own fish and build a cozy little aquarium. And if you like, set it as your animated desktop wallpaper! Watch your drawings come to life. Feed them, raise them and collect golden scales to unlock new decorations. There's also some handy tools to help you focus and unwind.
4045480.name: Drawquarium

4045760.desc: After losing your job, you return to your hometown to rebuild your life—and your family house. But you’re not alone. Two old friends, Lola and Mira, offer to help you renovate… and maybe build something more.
4045760.name: Project: Home!

4051290.desc: Tape Man is a puzzle platformer full of hidden mechanics. Throw your tape measure and set off into a vast maze built out of puzzles. The tape measure can serve as both a platform to stand on and a key to opening new paths — and it can do a lot more than that. You'll just have to find out.
4051290.name: Tape Man

4063180.desc: A choice-driven adult visual novel where you play as an immortal navigating romance, betrayal, supernatural mysteries, and meaningful relationships shaped by every decision you make.
4063180.name: DriftBorne

4066520.desc: A multi-ball roulette roguelite. Spin multiple balls at once and rewrite the wheel: add colors, change the numbers, rebalance payouts and stack multipliers with 100+ mementos and 50 trick balls. You’re live on a twisted TV show, and the puppet Host is grinning. Hit his targets, or the show ends you.
4066520.name: Trust Your Gut

4073100.desc: A horror game about the night shift at a donut shop. To help pay for your sister's treatment, you take seven nights behind the counter. Fry, glaze and box the orders, and serve the customer who comes in after closing and knows far too much about you.
4073100.name: Dreadnut

4076370.desc: Ride a hospital elevator through an abandoned ICU. On every floor, search the ward for anomalies. Nothing wrong? Go up. Something off? Go down. One wrong call sends you back to floor 1. Reach floor 13 to escape, if Lucy lets you.
4076370.name: ICU Anomaly

4077740.desc: PUBG: Black Budget is an extraction shooter built around tension, survival, and the unknown. Join a classified operation and uncover the secrets of a mysterious island trapped in a time loop.
4077740.name: PUBG: Black Budget

4080220.desc: Welcome to The World’s Game in EA SPORTS FC™ 27. Step into The Grounds to experience a football playground where the streets meet the stadium, and feel greater control in every mode as community-driven innovations deliver more true-to-football gameplay.
4080220.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 27

4082030.desc: Decorate the DreamHouse™ through the decades, while playing classic Barbie games. In Barbie™ Rewind, Barbie invites you into her cozy, creative world and entrusts you to customize her DreamHouse. Barbie also left you her game collection, so you can revisit your favorite Barbie video games.
4082030.name: Barbie™ Rewind

4083130.desc: A PvE roguelike deckbuilder where you can customise your deck with thousands of unique cards. Upgrade, draft, and buy new cards to field a respectable army on unique battlefields that favour tactical movement and card play. Master the five factions and stand Against the Horde.
4083130.name: Against the Horde

4088360.desc: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.
4088360.name: Funeral for the Sun

4095380.desc: From the creators of Warframe emerges a new Fantasy Action RPG. Forge your legend with blade, bow, and magick as you lead the charge against a world-devouring corruption.
4095380.name: Soulframe

4096910.desc: Organize. Optimize. Obliterate. Void Reaver is a sci-fi bullet heaven where your backpack is your firepower. Grid-manage 300+ weapons and artifacts into explosive synergies, unlock specialized skill trees, and blast through alien hordes to a high-octane electronic soundtrack.
4096910.name: Void Reaver

4099810.desc: 1999. The protagonist, a boy named Akira, finds himself lost in the TOKOYO Building—an indoor amusement park filled with secrets and eerie rumors. There, he begins living and working alongside its peculiar staff, but... did you know? People disappear in the TOKOYO Building.
4099810.name: 1999TOKOYO Building

4114080.desc: The political sandbox game where you build a career from state rep to the presidency. Authentic electoral systems, government departments, pass legislation, and a unique news landscape. Create custom scenarios, parties, and politicians in this data-driven democracy simulator.
4114080.name: StateOS: The Political Sandbox

4115450.desc: S-GAME presents Phantom Blade Zero, a fusion of classic Wuxia storytelling and exhilarating action powered by Unreal Engine 5. You play as Soul, a warrior with only sixty-six days left to live. Fend off assassins, unravel world-ending conspiracies, and defend your values with your life.
4115450.name: Phantom Blade Zero

4116260.desc: Hack into cameras, watch your hotwife, and use temptation as a tool to expose the truth behind a corporate heist. NTS/NTR unavoidable!
4116260.name: In-Security

4118000.desc: Thousands of aliens are coming. Expand your territory and build an army on a turn-based world map, then hold the line in real-time battle when a raid hits. Survive until the Final Assault on day 50.
4118000.name: Pest Termina ~ Swarm Defense

4119020.desc: Co-op Horror (4 players). Enemies mimic your teammates, environment lies to you. A brutal corporation promises you freedom, can your team survive the chaos?
4119020.name: Doomed Crew

4126040.desc: Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. Explore the vast continent of Idyll, Twine with unique Aniimo, unlock new abilities. Travel to a sky-floating metropolis, meet other Pathfinders, and battle in exciting competitions. Choose your Aniimo and begin your epic journey!
4126040.name: Aniimo

4126400.desc: You embody Baihu, a swift tiger. Before you lie the guardian lands, a magnificent landscape to explore at your leisure, filled with challenges. Your goal? Succeed in the trial of the gods to become one of the guardian beasts of the world.
4126400.name: Rise Of Baihu

413150.desc: You've inherited your grandfather's old farm plot in Stardew Valley. Armed with hand-me-down tools and a few coins, you set out to begin your new life. Can you learn to live off the land and turn these overgrown fields into a thriving home?
413150.name: Stardew Valley

4135440.desc: Crown's Trial is a Souls-Lite Boss Rush where each battle takes place in a different realm. Master tight combat mechanics to defeat legendary heroes inspired from various historical eras like Ancient Rome, Feudal Japan, the Crusades, and many more.
4135440.name: Crown's Trial

4136760.desc: Towerbit8 is a tower defense game with platformer mechanics, where you must defeat waves of enemies to build your defenses using directional turrets and defeat the 8 bosses that rule the invading monsters.
4136760.name: TowerBits8

4140210.desc: A party-builder rogue like, build your party to survive the monsters guarding the crystal. Master the turn-based combat system and break your limits to see how far you can take your party.

4150720.desc: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.
4150720.name: Drunken Goddess Reflux

4162040.desc: Zenless Zone Zero is HoYoverse’s brand-new urban fantasy ARPG. Players act as "Proxies" who explore Hollows alongside a wide range of unique Agents, fighting enemies, and completing commissions on their journey to unveil the mysteries behind New Eridu.
4162040.name: Zenless Zone Zero

4165740.desc: An automation roguelike where a run fits in one session. Place hexagonal tiles to grow a production organism while the resource demands rise over time. Roll dice in the shop to buy more tiles, and pick perks that change the rules and try to completely break the economy.
4165740.name: Vena: Hex Automation Roguelike

4165870.desc: Your games at your fingertips All the inputs to play all the games on Steam, wherever Steam is
4165870.name: Steam Controller

4165890.desc: Your games in every dimension Wireless, comfortable, lightweight VR for your Steam library
4165890.name: Steam Frame

4165910.desc: Your games on the big screen Powerful PC gaming made easy, in a small and mighty package
4165910.name: Steam Machine

4168680.desc: A fast-paced arena action roguelike about mercenaries fighting on the edge of the galaxy. Choose your hero, battle hordes of aliens, create powerful builds, and turn your body into the ultimate weapon with combat implants.
4168680.name: Doom Keeper

4171850.desc: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...
4171850.name: Trees Hate You

4178790.desc: Clicky Islands is an incremental game with a full city builder inside. Settle procedurally generated islands, build production chains, put your workers to work and ship goods for gold as your economy grows. Unlock permanent upgrades and find the perfect island for His Majesty’s future kingdom
4178790.name: Clicky Islands

417910.desc: First, realistic PvP brawling game for up to 8 vs 8 players with original, dynamic combat system and fast, round based battles. Create and develop Your character. Earn new skills and items that helps You beat Your opponents. Gather Your friends and fight together in a clan.
417910.name: Street Warriors Online

4179990.desc: A farming and automation game where your automation is people. Hire workers, pay their salaries, build their houses, and lay out your farms and factories like a town. Produce and sell valuable goods to keep your business profitable. This isn't colony survival, it's running a company.
4179990.name: Agromatic

4181790.desc: A collection of four atmospheric horror games about brokenness and malfunction. Inspect toys for defects, cheat on an exam, follow a radio signal, and explore the darkness by the light of matches.
4181790.name: Broken Horror Anthology

4183130.desc: Experience minigame chaos in WE’RE ALL IN!, an online party game for 1-8 players where you win by betting on your friends in a series of fast-paced games and challenges.
4183130.name: WE'RE ALL IN!

4184810.desc: An adrenaline-pumping bullet heaven where death is permanent. Hire and evolve unique companions, discover 950+ weapon variations, and fight through swarms of enemies and bosses. Grow stronger every run, but if your team falls, they're gone for good.
4184810.name: Bullet Meltdown

4185040.desc: A collection 48 lovingly hand crafted and hand-drawn micro games. Play with just a mouse and shoot for ALL the high scores! Try a random selection of games, or play each individually!
4185040.name: The Great 48

4185770.desc: cenker's mod is a multiplayer physics sandbox with many mods. Every mod has a different experience. Play included, community-made, and your own mods together with friends.
4185770.name: cenker's mod

4189160.desc: On Love, On Monsters is a Frankenstein-inspired story with an emphasis on love in its many forms. Play as three characters with alternating POVs; the Doctor, The Priest, and The Exile. Bond with allies and enemies, avoid raising suspicion in the town of Blackmoore, and learn what it means to love.
4189160.name: On Love, On Monsters

4191110.desc: Two vampires — an ambitious Kindred and a wretched Thinblood. Their fates clash in this Visual Novel set in the World of Darkness, where your arsenal extends beyond just words — from political machinations to forbidden Alchemy. Claw your way to power and leave your bitemarks on Berlin's underworld.
4191110.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths & Ashes

4199910.desc: Experience the brutal fusion of galactic strategy and grimdark warfare in Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000. Take command of iconic factions, customise your war machine, and engage in devastating battles as you carve a bloody warpath across the stars.
4199910.name: Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000

4207260.desc: Fall in love and relax with gorgeous women! Build the Greatest Festival of Pleasure of this era & improve your skills to seduce all the ladies in this incremental dating sim~
