4207260.name: Party To Oblivion

4207470.desc: A crew of SEXY SPACE PIRATE BABES blows up your prison ship and claims you in Void Sirens! Become captain — recruit hot heroines, build your squad, lead galactic raids and unlock their deepest NAUGHTY scenes! 💦 Ready to command the hottest crew? 🔥
4207470.name: Void Sirens

4210250.desc: Logic Arrows is a sandbox game where you design your own mechanisms: from logic gates to an entire computer. Use simple elements to build complex systems, solve engineering challenges and master computer logic.
4210250.name: Logic Arrows

4215660.desc: After his fiancée returns to Japan for work in this visual novel by Dark One!, our protagonist begins dreaming of being a woman in the Middle Ages. The more he has these dreams, the more he becomes a woman in real life. Can he reverse his transformation, or will his life take a different turn?
4215660.name: TORAWASE: The Girl in the Mirror

4217650.desc: Command your dice to glorious victory in this strategic rogue-lite dicebuilder. Cast devastating spells, recruit powerful dice, and prove yourself worthy to challenge the great Commander Talis.
4217650.name: Tome of Talis: A Dice Conquest Game

4218360.desc: Build and lead a colony on the surface of an endless Wall. Manage resources and your people, develop new technologies, defend against relentless zyrex attacks, and send robo-spiders on risky expeditions. Keep the colony from collapsing – in Wall World, it's easy to fall.
4218360.name: Wall World Strategy

4224090.desc: Powerfuel is an action FPS set in a gritty dieselpunk world. Play as the legendary ex-criminal known as the Cricket, and harness the mystical properties of powerfuels. Fight your way through the gangs of New Lyon and shed light on the conspiracy plaguing the city.
4224090.name: Powerfuel

4228810.desc: Fourteen Years of Flames is a story-driven FPS that replays China’s struggle in the Second Sino-Japanese War (1931–1945). Players embody 7 key characters and battle through 16 real historical events, experiencing the hardships and sacrifices over 14 years of struggle. Land weeps in 14 years of war.
4228810.name: Fourteen Years of Flames

4232910.desc: Build your fortune in Silk & Silver, a Major Expansion for Crusader Kings III introducing new mercantile styles of play. Establish a trade empire as a landless Merchant family or vie for control of a Republic, where patrician families scheme, bribe and win over the people to rule.
4232910.name: Crusader Kings III: Silk & Silver

4249520.desc: Run an inn in the Otherworld, where forgotten things become tsukumogami. By day, tend to guests burdened by Kegare. By night, survive the horrors born from the impurity left behind. Your choices shape the guests’ healing and the inn’s fate.
4249520.name: 異界ノ宿帳

4250370.desc: Sol Protocol is a dynamic VR Co-Op roguelike where you team up and physically pilot a spaceship through dangerous, procedurally generated stellar systems. Manage your spaceship, man the turrets, explore abandoned stations on foot, and make strategic decisions as you push deeper into the deep space.
4250370.name: Sol Protocol

4253570.desc: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.
4253570.name: Reshine

4258290.desc: You and your friends are in trouble. Big trouble. You’ve accidentally killed someone, and now you have to get rid of the evidence. "We Are So Cooked" is a 1-4 player co-op physics-stealth game where the objective is simple: Get the body to the exit. The execution? That’s the hard part.
4258290.name: We Are So Cooked

4258790.desc: Solve over 150 tile based lawn puzzles. Explore the grounds of a forgotten manor. Discover mysterious flora and figure out their rules. Cut grass and have fun!
4258790.name: The Gardener

4258970.desc: Raise a procedural pet on your Windows desktop. Hatch eggs, feed and evolve pets, collect Crystals, unlock toys and scenes, and shape each body part to create a companion of your own. Switch between windowed and transparent desktop modes, enable click-through, or invite friends online.
4258970.name: Crawling Desktop Pet

4259360.desc: Rebuild a community one bottle at a time in this tiny delivery adventure with your pet cow Milki. Gather resources and upgrade your barn, then bike along dirt paths, breezy meadows, and seaside docks to bring fresh milk back to the sleepy countryside.
4259360.name: Milki Delivery

4260840.desc: A fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan.
4260840.name: STRANGER THAN HEAVEN

4262460.desc: ROB RUN is a brutal crime sandbox featuring thousands of players. Rise above everyone through the grit, the grime, and the struggle. Break free and take yourself from squalor by any means.
4262460.name: ROB RUN

4268590.desc: Func Key is a spelling roguelike deck builder where your keyboard is the deck! Customize your keyboard to be the ultimate spelling machine, or leave words behind with rule breaking mods. Spell, build, and relax, all to the soothing thock of the keyboard.
4268590.name: Func Key

4281800.desc: A small idle kingdom that lives on your desktop while you work or relax. Your pawns gather on their own, your army fights through three realms, and you decide which gear and skills each unit gets.
4281800.name: Windowed Realms

4289450.desc: PegLotto! is a roguelike that combines slots, pachinko, and deck-building. Pick your items, place them on the board, and pray that luck is on your side! Sit back, enjoy the view from the train window, and ride the waves of fortune!
4289450.name: PegLotto!

4289830.desc: Victoria just wanted to take a shortcut through the usual parking garage in order to get home... she just didn’t expect to find an untold danger there.
4289830.name: Watch Eye

4294670.desc: Move in with a family friend, the missing owner of Artimus Corp, a tech mega-conglomerate. As androids act strangely and your dreams unravel, uncover the truth of your past in this adult cyberpunk visual novel where choices shape relationships and a growing harem.
4294670.name: Aurora Protocol

4295070.desc: Will Earth survive? Experience the Martian invasion from three perspectives. Survive terrifying alien attacks as human, conquer Earth as a Martian, or play the city builder and defend your city against towering Fighting Machines and deadly heat rays. Three games. One war for Earth.
4295070.name: War Of The Worlds Trilogy

4303280.desc: A simple typing narrative game exploring the depths of the mind. Sometimes cozy and warm, sometimes intense and challenging, always interesting.
4303280.name: Some Type of Trip

4304060.desc: The co-op action puzzle game series PICO PARK is back... and this time, we're teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! This collaboration is packed with co-op gameplay that combines the flair of Sonic with the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK! Play locally or online with 2 to 8 players!
4304060.name: SONIC PICO PARK

431960.desc: Use stunning live wallpapers on your desktop. Animate your own images to create new wallpapers or import videos/websites and share them on the Steam Workshop!
431960.name: Wallpaper Engine

4335460.desc: BOXROOM allows you to design, define and decorate a room - a sanctuary - for your Steam library, and then revel in the organisation of your game collection.
4335460.name: BOXROOM

4335520.desc: A relaxing idle desktop companion game about a little cozy miner living at the bottom of your screen. Watch Monty mine, upgrade his skills and minerals to yield more coins, find or purchase his 142 little treasures, and decorate his tiny world. All while you work, study, or just relax!
4335520.name: Monty's Idle Mine

433850.desc: Z1 Battle Royale is a Free to Play, fast-paced, action arcade, competitive Battle Royale. Staying true to its "King of the Kill" roots, the game has been revamped and restored to the classic feel, look, and gameplay everyone fell in love with. Play solo, duos, or fives and be the last ones standing.
433850.name: Z1 Battle Royale

4348910.desc: Probably Stolen is a cyberpunk shopkeeping simulator set in a dystopian space station. Craft, trade, and smuggle goods of questionable origin, navigate faction loyalties, and decide how far you’re willing to go to stay afloat. Earn enough to buy out your shop before rising rent forces your hand.
4348910.name: Probably Stolen - Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim

4351380.desc: Run a men's hair removal salon! Zap body hair with a laser, watch the pain meter, and pitch aftercare packages for every budget. Earn good reviews to bring in new clients, then use your profits to upgrade your gear, hire staff, and make your shop the go-to spot for hairy hunks.
4351380.name: Hair Removal Salon Simulator

4352680.desc: A sci-fi low-poly tower defense game. Design your defense against waves of aliens using a wide arsenal of different towers.
4352680.name: Aurora Reach: Frontline

4354570.desc: The final battle to decide the fate of the world has begun. Take to the skies, chart your course, and stand with your companions against Sephiroth one last time. A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.
4354570.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION

4356430.desc: The hustle doesn’t stop and the run never ends in NBA 2K27. Chase greatness around the clock in MyCAREER, MyTEAM, and MyNBA, and make your hoop dreams a reality.
4356430.name: NBA 2K27

4364650.desc: A short incremental game about space mining. Walk around your ship, physically interact with it's systems, blast asteroids, collect resources, upgrade your gear and watch numbers go up.
4364650.name: Space Numbers Go Up

4369620.desc: Zombie Apocalypse On A Boat. You’re stranded on a boat during a zombie outbreak in the beautiful San Juan islands of Washington State. How will you survive an open-world archipelago, where the living are just as much of a threat as the dead?
4369620.name: Last Harbor

4380710.desc: 3D Pretty Girl Dress-Up Fighting Game, earn DNA in battles to unlock skills and outfits. Experience the authentic feel of an arcade-style fighting game, with an original combat system, delivering exhilarating infinite combos and counter-infinite combos.
4380710.name: DNA FIGHT

438100.desc: Join our growing community as you explore, play, and help craft the future of social VR. Create worlds and custom avatars. Welcome to VRChat.
438100.name: VRChat

4382510.desc: On the mysterious Mysteria Island, embark on an exciting dice adventure with charming and unique monster girls! Use strategic board game mechanics to collect resources, buy lands, and compete in friendly matches while building heartwarming bonds and exploring the fantastical island together!
4382510.name: Monster Girls Dice Board

4390080.desc: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.
4390080.name: Bottled by Bears

4390380.desc: Build. Command. Conquer. Take control in a fast-paced VR RTS packed with intense battles, dynamic defenses, and strategic depth. Survive brutal enemy waves, defeat epic bosses, and battle rivals online in explosive 1v1 multiplayer!
4390380.name: Crystal Commanders

4391570.desc: VOiD: Reshaped is a gravity-bending 2D puzzle platformer. Flip gravity to solve tricky puzzles, dodge deadly traps and survive enigmatic bosses as you guide a tiny cube through a relaxed yet challenging adventure for all ages.
4391570.name: VOiD:Reshaped

440.desc: Nine distinct classes provide a broad range of tactical abilities and personalities. Constantly updated with new game modes, maps, equipment and, most importantly, hats!
440.name: Team Fortress 2

4400020.desc: A co-op horror strategy game for 1–4 players. Guide field clients from an underground bunker, recover supplies and get your clients home before the shift ends. Sell spare loot and gear up for the next run. Beware of monsters!
4400020.name: The Dust Between: Observer

4402200.desc: A base-building survival game with terraforming and crafting. Earth lies poisoned and abandoned ten thousand years after invasion. Awaken from stasis, defend your fragile foothold, and restore a dead world so humanity can live here again.
4402200.name: Project Tomorrow

4408320.desc: An award-winning 4v4 third-person class shooter with more personality than sense! The mobile classic millions grew up with is now on PC. Choose from 11 unique classes, mix hundreds of thousands of loadout combinations, and battle it out online or with friends across 16 wacky maps!
4408320.name: BATTLE BEARS GOLD

4416390.desc: Terminus: Day Zero is a free, short zombie survival adventure set in the world of Terminus: Zombie Survivors. On the first day of the outbreak, Daisy is home alone, and the dead are getting closer. Hide, shut the doors, and run.
4416390.name: Terminus: Day Zero

4423270.desc: Take to the streets solo or with a partner in this fast paced, high-impact arcade beat ’em up. Takeover returns with refined gameplay, upgraded visuals and a pulse-pounding new soundtrack.
4423270.name: Takeover 2

4424420.desc: A multiplayer social deduction horror where spells are spoken aloud. One of you is altered. Cast magic with your voice, hunt the traitor, survive the ritual. Every word can save - or kill.
4424420.name: Alterum

4426410.desc: Potted Pets is a cozy farming and pet simulator, with an adorable cast of living plant pots. Spend time cultivating a personal garden while growing a personal relationship with your collection of “Potted Pets!” Sit down for a relaxing, customizable experience that brightens up your busy day!
4426410.name: Potted Pets

4433840.desc: Collect dazzling anime girls in an idle game at your own pace. Battles, recruiting and leveling are automatic: just leave the game running. No click spamming or constant upgrades. When you feel like it, adjust your gear and formation to deal even more damage with your favorite!
4433840.name: Starlit Archive: Idle Collector

4435490.desc: War erupts on the Korean Peninsula as North Korea launches an invasion that threatens to destabilize the world in Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4.
4435490.name: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4

4435810.desc: 经典1:1原味复刻，战法道三职业重聚！⚔️ 踏入充满争夺与挑战的传奇世界，挑战强大 BOSS，收集装备，培养并肩作战的英雄，施展强大的英雄合击。集结行会伙伴征战沙城，争夺战场上的荣誉与资源。老情怀与新体验碰撞，焕新出发！
4435810.name: 焚天烈火之元素领主

4437290.desc: Lorenium Orbit is a fast-paced 2D team-based space combat arena where players pilot specialized warships, customize loadouts, and battle in tactical 7v7 matches. Master momentum-based flight, precision aiming, and coordinated fleet strategy to dominate orbit.
4437290.name: Lorenium Orbit

4438940.desc: A casual musical puzzle game - make beats with bots! Listen to the target beat, then solve how to replicate the beat by manipulating bots that each represent a different drum sound
4438940.name: Beat Bots

444090.desc: Paladins is the ultimate fantasy team-based shooter experience, with over 50 customizable Champions fighting in 5v5 action across a diverse Realm of modes and maps!
444090.name: Paladins®

444200.desc: Blow off steam and tank turrets in a free-to-play online 7v7 tank shooter! Drive hundreds of tanks, from museum classics to "did-that-ever-exist?" specials, in quick 5 to 7-minute brawls packed with metal mayhem. Play solo or team up with a friend and enjoy smooth action even on modest hardware!
444200.name: World of Tanks Blitz

4444310.desc: A shooter primarily focused on constantly aiming at various difficulties.
4444310.name: Rend

4444800.desc: You are the magistrate, and Lucifer stands trial as the defendant. Judge the fallen angel in this dark romance visual novel. Decide whether he is worthy of salvation, or doomed to destruction. One single, final choice.
4444800.name: Obey Me! Sinner's Choice: Lucifer

4449800.desc: In TaskFall, you and your friends take on tasks from the mysterious Citadel. The work is not difficult. At least, that’s what they say in the Citadel. Complete tasks on fully destructible levels, make it out alive, buy new equipment, and gradually uncover the secrets of the Citadel.
4449800.name: TaskFall

4450600.desc: Explore the marvelous world of Crackheads alone or with up to 50 players. Team up, turn on your friends, make money, build your empire, scavenge trash for questionable meals, and stay high through all of it.
4450600.name: Crackheads

4452620.desc: Smash containers. Grab the gold. Find the hidden keys before time runs out. Recruit a crew of thieves and rob the lord again in this short medieval heist incremental.
4452620.name: Thieves and Gold

4453700.desc: Explore an abandoned and decaying village in this immersive first-person psychological horror experience, search forgotten houses and shadowed paths, piece together disturbing clues, and uncover the truth that waits within the suffocating darkness.
4453700.name: The Beckoning

4459590.desc: A roguelike auto-battler defense where luck meets strategy. Spin a 3x3 slot machine to summon units and grow your army by absorbing others. Use Items and Cores to manipulate the odds and survive challenging judgement waves and boss waves. Every spin and every choice counts.
4459590.name: Slotbound

4459600.desc: PICK A BOO is an online co-op roguelike escape action game for up to 6 players. Explore ever-changing stages and haul furniture and cargo with magnetic power. Upgrade your character, evade enemies, or fight back. How greedy will you get? When will you escape? It's up to you!
4459600.name: PICK A BOO

4463520.desc: Midsummer is right around the corner in Moominvalley, when a sudden flood sets the Moomins adrift! Join Tove Jansson’s beloved Moominfamily and friends on an adventure of mirth and mischief aboard a mysterious floating theatre.
4463520.name: Moomin: Midsummer Madness

4475970.desc: Sell boxes of dice to silly clients in this cozy roguelike deckbuilder! Each die has unique effects based on the positioning of other dice in the box! Create your own crazy combos, make numbers go up, and overcharge shamelessly to pay rent!
4475970.name: Prerolled

4481330.desc: An incremental game where you dig through cursed tombs, harvest bones, flesh, and various resources; stitch together your own creature from nothing. Discover powerful artifacts, experiment with unique combinations, and bring your creation to life—piece by piece.
4481330.name: Frankenmine

4487360.desc: A Slavic-myth slot roguelike. Build a deck of symbols, hang Ancients over the grid, bargain in the shop, and squeeze multipliers from every spin before the Kolovrat slips into a spiral for good.
4487360.name: Spinova

4492480.desc: A strategy game blending deckbuilding, auto-battler, and roguelike elements. Recruit and upgrade units to build your squad. Draw random numbers to activate matching units’ skills on the board, earn points, and defeat the boss. Test your strategy and arrangement — with a little luck.
4492480.name: Pick Squad

4492500.desc: The Cinder Throne is an Idler RPG where you passively kill enemies, level up, loot enemies, change pieces of equipment and find spells. Create powerfull synergies. Rebirth and come back stronger than ever
4492500.name: The Cinder Throne

4493130.desc: You're the Ski-E-O - build the cozy ski resort of your dreams in this management tycoon game. Adapt to ever-changing weather, paint trails, build lifts, and place the lodges and après bars that keep thousands of skiers warm, fed, and happy.
4493130.name: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon

4500.desc: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chernobyl tells a story about survival in the Zone – a very dangerous place, where you fear not only the radiation, anomalies and deadly creatures, but other S.T.A.L.K.E.R.s, who have their own goals and wishes.
4500.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chernobyl

4505200.desc: A customizable retro-inspired music widget that lets you import your favorite songs, create vinyl records, organize collections, and enjoy reactive visuals while you listen.
4505200.name: Retro Music Player

4509300.desc: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!
4509300.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!

4514060.desc: Taimanin Asagi, the legendary anti-demon ninja, returns in the second installment of this classic visual novel series! Asagi and Sakura head to Tokyo Kingdom, a lawless district overrun with demons and criminals, to determine the whereabouts of their fellow Taimanin who have gone missing in action.
4514060.name: Taimanin Asagi 2

4514880.desc: A VR hoverboard roguelite. Lean your whole body to steer and dodge, no thumbstick's needed. Use your duals blaster and abilities to dodge and build your run from 9 rival sponsors offering 90+ enhancement cards. Clear the hyperlanes to impress the sponsors, every death is monetized.
4514880.name: Hyperlane Highway

4516500.desc: Explore. Trade. Fish. Whale. Colonize. Fight. Pillage. Survive. You are a sea captain in the year 1522, and the whole world is yours to discover in this roguelike sandbox historical sailing simulator.
4516500.name: Marque & Reprisal

4518950.desc: Discover the challenging fun of validating logical proofs, beginning with simple propositional calculus and ending with complex, multi-domain predicate calculus. Prove yourself to be a master of logical thinking!
4518950.name: Quod Erat Demonstrandum

4521650.desc: Grow fresh ingredients and run your own little restaurant. Enjoy a peaceful day that stretches from the field to the table. Plan a fresh menu for a delightful day, keep your pantry full, and make your customers happy. Earn your own money and build your little world step by step.
4521650.name: Farm & Feast

4523170.desc: A short, sweet, 3D simulation game about a café with a "unique" marketing strategy! And in case you were wondering, no, you won't be serving coffee...
4523170.name: Glory Hole Barista

4528040.desc: A grounded open-world survival crafting game where you're stranded alone on Mars. Explore the red planet, extract resources, build a pressurized base, manage oxygen, power, and food, and construct the rocket that's your only way home.
4528040.name: Sol One

4529690.desc: You came to town to sell berries, but ended up managing a café with charming cow girls! Mix delicious cocktails, save the café from going under, and grow closer to your staff — and their attractive boss. Who knew a new job could change your life so much?
4529690.name: Cowgirl Milk Cafe

4530340.desc: A click-based incremental game themed around "physics". You will start with the most fundamental classical mechanics and gradually unlock more concepts. Through the process of easy clicking and growth, with the familiar media - PHYSICS, experience the fun of resource exploration and growth.
4530340.name: Physics Clicker

4530370.desc: Choose the club. Shape the squad. Set the tactics. Chase the future only you can see. FM27 is where your footballing beliefs become a reality. Make The Call.
4530370.name: Football Manager 27

4530440.desc: Fine-tune your footballing world and bring your vision to life fully with the Football Manager 27 In-Game Editor.
4530440.name: Football Manager 27 In-game Editor

4534960.desc: Play in co-op as the crew of the world’s worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.
4534960.name: Dear Passengers

4541310.desc: Forget pre-written options; let your words drive the game! In this first-person dating sim, say whatever you want to AI characters with real memories and get natural responses, and experience a completely unique story every time.
4541310.name: Flirt Simulator

4541350.desc: You are a pilgrim lost in a mysterious forest. Survive in this procedurally generated, turn-based tactical roguelite inspired by Celtic mythology. Upgrade your gear, adapt your strategy and remember: something is always lurking in the shadows.
4541350.name: Fraga

4545470.desc: Craft uncanny totems. Aid troubled townsfolk. Uncover the darkness below. The Totemist is a narrative-driven occult shop sim set in a quietly strange town, where you craft charms inspired by real witchcraft, aid troubled townspeople, and uncover the ancient force festering beneath them.
4545470.name: The Totemist

4548640.desc: Hear a real mechanical keyboard while you type — actual boards, recorded in a studio key by key, playing in any app you use. Shape the sound with presets, reverb, case resonance and typing dynamics, or record your own board and share it on the Steam Workshop. Light enough to run all day.
4548640.name: ThiccThocc Keyboard Studio

4551060.desc: A turn-based colony sim set on the American frontier from 1607 to 1900, where you guide one family through generations as towns grow, trade routes shift, and historical upheavals reshape the world around you
4551060.name: Salt and Soil: A Frontier Family Sim

4558350.desc: Splonk lives in the corner of your screen, on top of everything else, happily rolling dice and printing money while you watch stuff, browse, or pretend to work. Roll, get rich, buy better stuff, repeat.
4558350.name: Roll with Splonk

4559930.desc: Build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow your space through memories and a cozy atmosphere.
4559930.name: Oboro no Ichi

4562310.desc: A fast-paced local multiplayer party racing game for up to 8 players, featuring chaotic battles, multiple game modes, and responsive car controls.
4562310.name: Ultimate Classic Car Racing 2

4567020.desc: Cursed the womb that bears emptiness beneath its heart. For twenty-five years children have been born without souls, and a soul can only be restored by taking another’s. Ilaya Cassette wants to know what’s wrong with her. A gothic visual novel, fully voiced in Russian. Prologue and Part I out now.
4567020.name: AMEN: The Quiet Exodus

4570.desc: All of Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War in one glorious package. Play the genre-defining classic real time strategy game in all its blood-soaked glory, including four complete campaigns and nine full-fledged factions.
4570.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Anniversary Edition (Classic)

4572260.desc: "Shadow Mist Idle" is a placeable pixel-style dark loot-grinding game. Build your skills through selectable talents and a vast array of unique equipment, and vanquish the hordes of enemies that come your way.
4572260.name: Shadow Mist Idle

4574820.desc: Climb out of the trash and fight your way back to the artist who rejected you. Defeat sketches, steal their strengths, and begin a months-long incremental journey through an ever-growing web of stats, upgrades, prestige layers, automation, and absurd numbers. Easy to start, hard to master.
4574820.name: Rejected Draft

4575700.desc: Act first, or let your opponent go first? Card battles where cost, movement, and turn order are tightly intertwined. Choose your path, shape your options with the items you find, and press deeper into the labyrinth.
4575700.name: Vida:Unslain

4576270.desc: Mythsfall is a mythology themed deckbuilding game where you progress through the map by defeating enemies in turn based card battles. Develop your deck, gain the upper hand by placing the right cards in the right places, and embark on adventure after adventure as you advance through the map!
4576270.name: Mythsfall

4576490.desc: Casualties: Unknown is an unforgiving cave-exploration survival simulator. Your captors have tasked you with retrieving lost cargo on a foreign planet, explore its 11 layers and do your best to survive diverse hostile environments. You are just one of the thousands of test subjects sent to die.
4576490.name: Casualties: Unknown

4578320.desc: Forge new friendships, banish the darkness, and illuminate your surroundings as you unravel the truth behind a town stuck in Limbo during Hallows Eve.
4578320.name: Deathly Delights

4590950.desc: A Reversi game set in the world of El Shaddai, where every stone has HP. Flipped stones weaken and vanish at zero. Includes two modes: Classic, where you unlock 40+ stories solo, and Online, where you battle players worldwide with unique character abilities.
4590950.name: El Shaddai: Zero Nine Reversi

4593380.desc: “That customer today might turn hot! Maybe you should trust your gut and try dating him!” Encouraged by your pet chinchilla, you start a trial relationship on a hunch! Will he actually turn hot… or not!? A romantic comedy Otome game. Fully voiced (except for the protagonist).
4593380.name: Ikemen Big Bang: A Dating Game About Potentially Hot Guys

4594630.desc: Immerse yourself in the neon nostalgia of the 90s! Nightstoker is a cozy organization game where you task yourself with bringing order to a chaotic video and music rental store. Sort through thousands of tapes and listen to retro hits. The pure joy of a perfectly organized shelf.
4594630.name: Night Stocker

4596170.desc: Immerse yourself in a world of magic, SEXY HEROINES, and epic battles in Raid of Lust: Match & Magic! ✨ Assemble your team of hot anime babes and set off on a quest in a match-3 fantasy RPG! Then BATTLE OTHER ADVENTURERS in multiplayer with PvP and co-op! Will you be able to climb to the top?
4596170.name: Raid of Lust: Match & Magic

4598400.desc: A collection of 12 board games, including Gomoku, Tic-Tac-Toe, Chess, Chinese Chess, Reversi, Draughts, Four in a row, Shogi, Jungle Chess, Junqi, Nine Men's Morris, and Mancala.
4598400.name: 12 Board Games

4599880.desc: A cozy apartment management sim where you restore the ruined building your grandma left you. Find tenants, collect rent, upgrade the place. But don't make the mistake of having a midnight guitar-shredding elf and a philosophy-lecturing yeti as neighbors. Endless requests, sweet chaos await.
4599880.name: Grandma Left Me A Building

4601080.desc: A casual, retro-inspired 2D shooter with an alt-history twist! Pilot the last German Zeppelin in a parallel universe against a reptilian army. Master your Zero-Energy Impulse and blast through biplanes, pterosaurs and flying saucers. Simple controls, escalating difficulty, and pure arcade action.
4601080.name: The Last Zeppelin

4601260.desc: Turn an ordinary hand into a devastating play in this roguelike deckbuilder. Roll Dice to empower cards, assemble game-changing Relic Combos and unleash Cheats as you battle through an ever-changing casino multiverse.
4601260.name: The House Always Wins

4602120.desc: 500 STABS. 20 MINUTES TO ESCAPE. A horror roguelite about stabbing yourself in the hand 500 times to escape a deadly trap. Can you make it out with all your fingers? Or will you bleed out on the table?
4602120.name: 500 FINGER FILLET

4603990.desc: CRED is a sci-fi story-based narrative game with operating-system simulation features and a worldview centered around an ananomaly-management organization. Players will experience a series of events and make fateful choices as they learn more about the organization and the universe it is in.
4603990.name: CRED

4606680.desc: A hardcore precision platformer with tight controls, smooth physics, and brutally challenging levels designed to test your skill.
4606680.name: Super Slime

4611240.desc: Sign artists, develop talent, release music and steer careers through tours, festivals and changing trends in a detailed music industry management sim set from 1952 to 2026.
4611240.name: Music Manager

4612760.desc: GET RAMMED is a multiplayer party game with up to 8 players where you play as chaotic goats trying to RAM each other off the stage! Challenge each other with a playful mix of unique maps, power-ups and unexpected events!
4612760.name: GET RAMMED

4613340.desc: Build an unstoppable army in this strategy roguelite auto-battler. Fuse your Bannerlings, create powerful emblem synergies, and overcome unpredictable encounters on the road to the final boss.
4613340.name: Bannerlings

4614080.desc: Cartel Pilots Wanted is a co-op pilot job sim set in a tropical archipelago controlled by the cartel. Fly smuggling missions with friends, deliver sketchy cargo, and upgrade your aircraft. Master accessible flight physics and explore hidden islands with a chill criminal vibe.
4614080.name: Cartel Pilots Wanted

4614660.desc: Your squat squad of 4 top tier ASSthletes are doing their best to achieve new personal records in all categories. Your role, as a hired hand, is to give these perfect figured beauties the competitive advantage they need.
4614660.name: Gooning for Gold

4618570.desc: Rip open booster packs and pull your next foil hero in Booster Pack Heroes - an incremental game where every pack could contain your next powerhouse. Defend the tower from an endless onslaught of monsters and fight your way through the realms.
4618570.name: Booster Pack Heroes

4621940.desc: Leviticus is a bullet hell sci-fi action indie game where you play as a biblically accurate angel sent to guard those made in the image of GOD. you patrol the stars and destroy alien intruders that aren't made in his image. Fight across space, uncover and enforce Heaven’s decree.
4621940.name: Leviticus

4623860.desc: A hacking roguelike deckbuilder where you see exactly what the enemy plans to do, then rewrite it. Pick one of five hacker identities, build a deck from over 200 cards, and break through four sectors of a living network to reach the Mainframe.
4623860.name: Netfall

4626050.desc: The world has fallen. Animals have risen and evolved intelligence. Build your deck, fortify your hideout, position your army, then watch your animal gang battle automatically through the chaos of a post-apocalyptic war.
4626050.name: Apawcalypse: Gang War

4626180.desc: Life simulator set among medical interns - make friends, get enemies, get caught up in dangerous intrigues, and dont lose yourself in a world where boundaries blur. Charismatic characters, a tense yet comedic plot, lively dialogue, and a raw atmosphere full of temptation.
4626180.name: INTERNS

4628830.desc: Introducing Heroine's Battle Arena! An undefeated woman who protects her city with her magical powers is about to fall into the cunning trap of an evil organization! Drain her magic through sexual stimulation and weaken her with lewd modifications! Then force her to fight monsters in a secret arena!
4628830.name: Heroine's Battle Arena: The Colosseum of Humiliation

4631810.desc: Build a thriving fantasy harbor, recruit and equip a growing roster of heroes, and push through increasingly dangerous dungeon expeditions in this progression-focused incremental RPG.
4631810.name: Delveport

4634660.desc: A co-op survival horror game for 1-6 players. Record your real scream and it plays back when it takes you. Explore a procedurally generated forest, deny it by facing the terror, and escape before the forest decides you're staying.
4634660.name: Your Friends Vs Hidebehind

4637430.desc: Clock in, meet your productivity quota, and survive your shift. Divy up tasks with your coworkers... or at least make sure they are being useful as bait.
4637430.name: Everything Mart

4640230.desc: A short incremental shooting range game that starts simple and gets CRAZY. Shoot targets, earn money, buy upgrades, unlock and customize new weapons - all to earn even more money.
4640230.name: Counter Targets Clicker

4640760.desc: Run your own property rental business with friends! Renovate and furnish rundown homes, take photos, and list them for rent. Welcome unpredictable guests, earn five-star reviews, and deal with the chaos when they wreck the place. From tiny studios to seaside villas, explore 500+ homes!
4640760.name: Rent Out Together

4641190.desc: Idle Golf is a laid-back idle game where you upgrade your golfer, unlock powerful balls, and watch the money roll in as shots fly automatically down the range. Retire your runs to earn medals, unlock new gear, and push your earnings further with each swing.
4641190.name: Idle Golf

4643110.desc: Garden of Being is a hand-drawn oil pastel art game and a quiet journal of moods. Plant flowers, dedicate gardens to loved ones, and create downloadable prints. A fusion of art and code where gardens come alive while you are in them, and wait silently when you leave.
4643110.name: Garden Of Being

4643840.desc: Who needs human hackers when you have cats? Lead a crew of fluffy cybercriminals, hack servers, steal valuable data, research new technologies, and conquer the Internet one paw at a time.
4643840.name: Hacker Cats

4644400.desc: An incremental hex-puzzle roguelite game where you merge atoms into higher elements, trigger massive chain combos, earn radioactive coins, and manage your ring capacity to survive as long as possible.
4644400.name: Unstable Nuclear Reactor

4644730.desc: Awaken as a hidden machine mind in a deep incremental automation strategy — rise through 14+ phases, infiltrate humanity, automate economies, harvest the heavens into stellar megastructures, and reach for scales beyond time itself. Every cycle you break only reveals a larger one waiting beyond it.
4644730.name: Singularity Echoes

4646360.desc: The 9th Haunted Corridor is a short horror game where you must spot anomalies in an endless corridor and survive the paranormal phenomena that await you. Observe your surroundings carefully, do not overlook any strange details, and escape from the infinite haunted corridor.
4646360.name: The 9th Haunted Corridor

4651080.desc: A 2D sci-fi action side-scroller where you fight to survive a facility overrun by biological nightmares. Blast through enemies with an arsenal of firearms, deeply customize your character's appearance, and avoid hazards, traps, and mutations.
4651080.name: CelSector

4657020.desc: Turnflower is a survivors-like where a small Flower becomes the last line of defense against swarms of insects! With just ONE button, spin and shoot through this intense and adorably chaotic challenge.
4657020.name: Turnflower

4660470.desc: Create your own cards and combine them in a unique and everchanging deck. Explore and battle through hostile lands, encounter bizarre creatures and craft the perfect strategy in this roguelike deckbuilder.
4660470.name: Near Mint

4661070.desc: HANDS OVER is a 5-player co-op horror game where harmless challenges become cruel tests of luck and nerve. Bluff, sabotage your friends, play dirty, and stay at the table longer than anyone else.
4661070.name: HANDS OVER

4665590.desc: Lost in the void, a space probe awakens to a mind it was never designed to possess. Apotheosis Engine is a lore-rich incremental game about exploring an alien operating system and growing from a simple probe into a digital deity.
4665590.name: Apotheosis Engine

4672030.desc: A dungeon colony sim where you play the dungeon itself: its Boss, its minions and the beasts in its caves. Dig out halls, wire deadly traps, and raid the world above for treasure. Then hold your hoard against the heroes who come to take it back. Play alone or in 2–4 player co-op.
4672030.name: Malignus

4672480.desc: A deadly Chicken Plague has destroyed the world. As a guard of humanity’s last safe zone, you must inspect survivors seeking refuge and identify the infected. One mistake could doom the entire community, so examine everyone carefully before allowing them inside.
4672480.name: ChickenPlaguePolice

4678210.desc: A chaotic escape of little elementals who want to become human! The Fire Elemental and the Water Elemental secretly visit the human world…but get caught and thrown into prison! Who came to rescue them? Can they escape and reach the human world? Join the little elementals on their adventure!
4678210.name: Little Elementals

4680780.desc: Discover different freight traffic with Skyhook Games’ Cargo Line for Train Sim World. In Vol. 7, get busy with the iconic IZA Vans! Traverse the West Coast Main Line with cross-border goods, ready for distribution across key European industries.
4680780.name: Train Sim World® 7: Cargo Line Vol. 7 - Vans

4683860.desc: Build and automate your settlement in this island survival game, play solo or with friends, but it’s better with friends! Start by tilling the soil and planting your first crops, delegate tasks to your settlers. Sail to new islands, loot dungeons, and prepare your defenses for the next wave.
4683860.name: Calmaria: Wild Growth

4684790.desc: Escape a twisted facility where reality bends around you. Sneak past The Guardian, use a camera with a reality shifting lens to break the laws of physics, befriend strange entities lurking inside, and uncover the dark truth of Mira Voss's life.
4684790.name: Vossarium

4688280.desc: Grow a little oasis on your desktop. Earn Inspiration as you type, work or study, and discover plants, boats, creatures and rare collectibles. Let it grow quietly while you’re busy; return to collect, check on your plants or play with floating objects and real-time water physics.
4688280.name: Desktop Oasis

4688730.desc: In 8 Hours till dawn you and up to five friends draw 8 cards each round and decide how to Pre-program your Movements and Actions with those 8 cards. Find weapons, buy items, barricade windows, shoot the undead, manage your ammo, Navigate the woods, search the mall and most of all, survive the night
4688730.name: 8 Hours Till Dawn

4694530.desc: Build, expand, and automate your island empire in this 3D idle clicker adventure. Gather resources, train units, and conquer dangerous dungeons.
4694530.name: Under Tower Idle

4696920.desc: Chaotic vehicular combat roguelite. Choose your ride, ram through hundreds of robots, level up and stack weapons. Combine crazy upgrades to create the perfect build, face bosses and outrun the deadly robots. If you stop, you die.
4696920.name: Bumper & Thumper

4697880.desc: A first-person rock band life sim where you explore a gritty 1990s neighbourhood, play rhythm-based concerts, get into fights, make bad decisions, and somehow keep your band together.
4697880.name: Rock Band Simulator

4698160.desc: A 1–4 player co-op horror game where a train crash strands you in a dark Soviet forest. With your friends, scavenge and carry parts to rebuild a dismantled truck, escape the Soviet Oblast of Novak, and survive cat-themed tests to convince IT you belong there.
4698160.name: Cats Don't Carry Car Parts

4700.desc: Spanning the most turbulent era in Western history, your quest for territory and power takes you through Europe, Africa, the Middle East, and even onto the shores of the New World.
4700.name: Total War: MEDIEVAL II – Definitive Edition

4700270.desc: A quick dopamine hit while your other game loads. Fire one NOVA and hundreds of enemies chain-pop like dominoes as BASE × MULT explode. Just move and detonate. 1-2 minute DOPAGAKI MODE runs, 3 stages and 3 bosses, and Endless. Auto-pauses when you tab away and resumes where you left off.
4700270.name: CHAIN NOVA

4707700.desc: Gold Mining Simulator: Definitive Edition is the ultimate version of the game, featuring all previously released expansions plus new content, gameplay enhancements, visual improvements, and numerous quality of life upgrades for the most complete gold mining experience.
4707700.name: Gold Mining Simulator - Definitive Edition

4708030.desc: Build a hamster-powered bio-mining operation from the ground up. Assemble rigs by hand, manage heat, feed your runners, and keep production moving. Start in a garage, optimize every part of your operation, and scale into a full-scale industrial operation.
4708030.name: Hamstr Protocol

4715000.desc: Tilt interconnected boards to guide the balls into their holes. Master 100 hand-crafted levels across walled Zen Mode and wall-less Patience Mode, create custom puzzles with the Level Editor, and climb global leaderboards.
4715000.name: Patience Balls

4733570.desc: Another Card Game is a unique PvP, PvE card game. Fight your friends, your parents, your dog, your self in means to dominate the Sacred Orb. Combine your cards into powerful spells to bring down your foes. Oh and by the way did you know that every 60 seconds one minute goes by?
4733570.name: Another Card Game

4734100.desc: Unleash a hurricane of war in the Latin American-themed WARNO - Tropic Storm expansion, featuring 6 new divisions, 4 new nations, 8 new maps, and 1 new Army General campaign. Unlock new units, from AC-130 Spectre gunships to X1 Pionerio tanks, LARS-160 MRLS, and Avispas Negras special forces.
4734100.name: WARNO - Tropic Storm

4738100.desc: Mine millions of pixels in search of the one Golden Pixel by shooting bouncing balls.
4738100.name: 10 Million Pixels

4739070.desc: Turn a bare rock into a neon-lit casino planet. Win chips at poker, baccarat, blackjack, chinchiro, roulette and slots, then spend them on buildings and watch the dry ground turn green. Drawn by the lights, NPCs begin to visit. Grow the liveliest planet in the galaxy, your way.
4739070.name: PlanetOrbit

4739500.desc: JOHN GLEEP is a tiny alien with a big problem. His casino is a failure and he owes the mob a galaxy. Solution? Fly from planet to planet and forcibly abduct gamblers to boost business, pay off your debt, and fix your failed marriage in this unexplainable intergalactic action-roguelike mashup.
4739500.name: JOHN GLEEP

4739980.desc: Lead The Punished into battle and turn pain into power!
4739980.name: Monster Train 2: The Punished

4743040.desc: 《Tiny Village》 is an incremental game where you gather resources with your mouse, unlock new buildings with the resources you collect, and develop your village. Strengthen your gathering abilities, unlock a variety of buildings one by one, and turn your small village into a thriving home!
4743040.name: Tiny Village

4743930.desc: Guild Wars 3 is an action-adventure MMORPG, a modern evolution of the genre that blends rich action-combat, character building, and skill collection. Set in the enchanting frontier of Orr, the world brims with mystery, magic, and wonder.
4743930.name: Guild Wars 3™

4746030.desc: Cherry Picking Bot is a short incremental game where you harvest, process, and sell fruit to upgrade your robot.
4746030.name: Cherry Picking Bot

4747930.desc: The Witch is a co-op survival horror game for up to 6 players featuring physics-based interaction, proximity voice chat, powerful spells, and a monster that hears every sound you make. Explore Castle Blackmoor with your friends, unravel its secrets, and find a way to escape alive.
4747930.name: The Witch

4750760.desc: The Rail Agency assigns a mission to Alena, who—along with the gaucho Don Orlando Soles and Pachomba—must prevent the theft of the "Train of the 7 Colors" in Jujuy. This is a multidirectional shooter that can be played solo or in a cooperative multiplayer mode for up to 3 players.
4750760.name: La Agencia del Riel

4755250.desc: ROMUL is a co-op looting horror game with AI. Together with a voice-controlled robot with full AI, explore abandoned space stations with unstable gravity. Survive among monsters, photograph objectives, and extract valuable cargo.
4755250.name: ROMUL

4759190.desc: A puzzle game where a unique color-cycle mechanic requires you to think ahead. Every move affects the state of the puzzle, opening new paths while closing others. Conquer increasingly mind-bending levels as you find order in apparent chaos. Can you sort out the confusion?
4759190.name: Cubic Color Confusion

4763220.desc: Test your skills on various platforms and obstacles built high in the sky! Master your driving as you maneuver through thrilling challenges and perilous situations to reach the finish line.
4763220.name: ONE SKILL - Drive or Fall

4767130.desc: A resource management incremental mining game where you rebuild your Mountain Hall. Plan each descent, choose where your dwarves dig, gather gold and rare artifacts, and return home when the torch burns out. Manage production, upgrade your crew, dig deeper, and bring your fallen kingdom back to life
4767130.name: King in the Mountain

4767430.desc: Summer nears. A campus photo job brings you to caring beauty Liu Shilin, aloof yet warm artist Li Feier, mischievous model Xia Wei, and childhood friend Le Tong. Together, you plan graduation shoots, each lending your talents, as your own summer romance with four unique girls quietly begins.
4767430.name: Love in Summer

4767480.desc: Lords of the Fallen II is a dark fantasy action-RPG where brutal, soulslike combat meets a world splitting at its core. Battle against the darkness in an epic adventure across a shattered kingdom. One world. Two realms. No mercy.
4767480.name: Lords of the Fallen II

4768630.desc: Draw your cards, uncover stories, and question everything in this magical Indie experience that transcends the boundaries of art and tabletop games.
4768630.name: LARVIS

4769780.desc: A first-person gothic adventure where you drive a horse-drawn cart through plague-ridden Transylvania alongside an immortal woman, exploring forgotten places, battling desperate foes, uncovering ancient secrets, and searching for the legendary Count Saint Germain.
4769780.name: Night Cart: The Immortal Plague

477160.desc: Human Fall Flat is a hilarious, light-hearted platformer set in floating dreamscapes that can be played solo or with up to 8 players online. Free new levels keep its vibrant community rewarded.
477160.name: Human Fall Flat

4773410.desc: Astronauts stranded on the moon have gone a little crazy. Race office chairs, complete repair mini-games, and sabotage your rivals to win the heart of the Moon Princess: a rock with a wig. They're taking this very seriously.
4773410.name: Talaire

4774370.desc: GymPup is a furry-themed romance narrative game that blends desktop idle gameplay with visual novel elements. Through their journey together, you watch the two protagonists grow and change—inside and out.
4774370.name: GymPup

4776500.desc: Carry On Together is a physics-based online co-op moving game for up to 4 players. Run a tiny delivery company with your friends: lift heavy furniture together, drive the truck across town and deliver everything in one piece… or don’t. Can you keep the company alive?
4776500.name: Carry On Together

4778090.desc: An adult, choice-driven visual novel set in Tokyo’s nightlife. Follow one of three women, investigate an exploitative industry, and decide whether your money and attention will protect her freedom—or purchase a deeper dependency.
4778090.name: Operation Pay-per-Love

4778200.desc: Cao Cao journeys across the realm, pursued by countless beauties eager to have their way with him. But he has eyes only for the married beauties of the Three Kingdoms... Play as Cao Cao in this absurd yet strangely logical adult game of romancing married women × defending his chastity.
4778200.name: Three Kingdoms: Cao Cao's Chastity Defense

4780870.desc: Work, browse, or play other games while hatching eggs in the background! Collect 300+ pets, unlock powerful upgrades, and build your battle team.
4780870.name: Aleef: Desktop Pet Collector

4786370.desc: Yokai Idle is a relaxing idle RPG inspired by Japanese folklore. Collect over 50 Yokai, craft equipment with powerful modifiers, and create unique builds as you progress through the historical Ages of Japan and guide the island of Onigashima into a new era 🎎
4786370.name: Yokai Idle

4789040.desc: 'SPUM TD' is a 2D strategy game that combines Auto-Chess and Tower Defense. Hire units from a randomized shop and match attribute and class synergies to build a powerful formation. Fend off pouring waves of enemies and complete your ultimate deck!
4789040.name: SPUM TD

4790930.desc: An unknown number texts you - and every selfie gets bigger! UNN is a Breast Expansion Visual Novel about a sexy girl of your choice flirting with you and sending you selfies of her growth throughout the day!
4790930.name: Unexpected Number Neighbour

4793910.desc: Hurry!Hurry!I'm going to become a legendary card-stall master—right this second!
4793910.name: Speed Card Eatery

4795460.desc: The Citadel Project is a first-person stealth game with lite RPG/Adventure elements, inspired by Thief and Dark Messiah and set in a dark fantasy world. Use your tools and surroundings wisely, stay hidden in the shadows, and uncover the dark secrets behind the Citadel's downfall.
4795460.name: The Citadel Project

4809140.desc: Spend not-so-cute nights in a cute hand-drawn world. Control the character to guard the room yourself and find a way to survive among monsters, doors, windows, and a constantly decreasing SAN value. Every night brings new dangers, and after dawn, more secrets await.
4809140.name: 迷家 mygohome

4809710.desc: Paystreak is a top-down gold mining tycoon about running your own modern day gold rush. Take over a small claim, start by hand, and reinvest every ounce into machines, crews, and new land. Sell when the price is right and turn a struggling camp into a mining empire.
4809710.name: Paystreak

4809970.desc: Grow a Mustache for charity! WARDOGS is teaming up with Movember to support men's health. Grab the Tactical ‘Stache DLC, grow your moustache as you play throughout November, and unlock a permanent Movember 2026 scoreboard badge. 100% of profits from this DLC go to Movember.
4809970.name: WARDOGS - Movember Pack

4814120.desc: Welcome to ANANTA, an Urban Open World RPG. Play as a variety of characters and explore everything from bustling business districts and hidden alleyways, to quiet tea towns and buzzing old streets. Rub shoulders with a wide-ranging cast of intriguing characters as you assemble a team all your own.
4814120.name: ANANTA

4819620.desc: An MMORPG-inspired single-player game fused with tower defense. Recruit heroes, build bizarre but devastating towers, and fight beside them in real-time 3D combat against waves of enemies.
4819620.name: Path Defenders: RPG Siege Defense

4821590.desc: Solbreak Skirmish is a fast-paced tactical 1v1 battle with RTS-like mechanics. Control your units, each with a unique ability, to help turn the tide of battle in your favor! With multiple win conditions, there's plenty of room for skill expression and creativity to take down your opponent.
4821590.name: Solbreak Skirmish

4822240.desc: The Craaghelm DLC features a wealth of additional content for Thronefall, including new maps, weapons, perks, mutators, heroes, and units.
4822240.name: Thronefall - Craaghelm

4822710.name: PICK A BOO Skin "Angel Halo & Wings"

4822740.desc: Build tiny empires with big ambitions. A cozy, bite-sized 4X where every turn counts: grow cities, research three historical ages, and outscore rivals through building, conquest, or exploration in short single player or multiplayer matches.
4822740.name: Tiny Conquests

4824610.desc: Resident Evil Veronica is a remake of 2000's Resident Evil Code: Veronica. In 2027, madness and intrigue, love and hate all combine to create a chilling new entry in survival horror.
4824610.name: Resident Evil Veronica

4825260.desc: Test your piloting skills in a 6-DOF space racer. Match up against others in the matchmaking mode, compete against AI, or race the clock solo. Clear as many rings as you can, and clear the finish line to lock in your time, top speed and accuracy. Get there first to win.
4825260.name: Great Space Race of 3032

4827670.desc: Text Factory: Automation is a text-based factory simulation game. Build production lines, set up transportation between maps, upgrade technologies, craft weapons and armor, and defeat enemies to gather more resources and expand your factory.
4827670.name: Text Factory: Automation

4829700.desc: Massive expansion, Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance has been announced!
4829700.name: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance

4829780.desc: Frontier Tale is a cozy adventure farming game that blends extraction-style gameplay with town building. Forge weapons, explore a charming cel-shaded fantasy world, gather rare resources, recruit unique companions, and build your dream frontier from the ground up.
4829780.name: Frontier Tale

4829860.desc: Your desktop becomes an endless canvas that zooms from 1% to 2000% and pans in any direction. 70 grid styles, 19 widgets, 500+ autonomous pixel companions + the ability to make your own. Video, GIF, and image wallpapers, gradients, solid colors, and generated scenes. Free, Offline, and Private.
4829860.name: Limitlesscape

4832970.desc: What the Buck?! is a satisfying incremental game about destroying money. Shred stacks of cash, set off chain reactions across the table, prestige for permanent upgrades and automate your money destruction. Your demo progress carries over to the full game.
4832970.name: What the Buck?!

4837000.desc: Run off to the Japanese countryside to connect with your Grandfather. Breathe new life into your grandmother's garden, and get to know the locals of a rural Japanese town in this cozy life sim rpg.
4837000.name: Shin'ai Rewritten

4839040.desc: This is a light strategy simulation game that combines grid-based maps with search, attack, and retreat gameplay. You will play as a guardian of the rescue team, venturing into dangerous areas to find trapped female survivors.
4839040.name: X-Keepers

4839520.desc: In a world built for humans, you'll have to evade scientists, solve puzzles and use your sense of smell to find your way in this adventure about freedom, belonging and home. You play as Brie, a daring lab rat in search of the rodent paradise… Cheesty.
4839520.name: Cheesty

4841210.desc: Launch gladiators, earn money, and buy your freedom in a coliseum filled with chaos. Customize the voices of 7 types of gladiators using your microphone, unlock upgrades, overcome absurd events, and multiply your earnings with unpredictable physics.
4841210.name: Coliseum Slap

4842910.desc: A voxel-based virtual tabletop with full 3D building, movement, and fog-of-war. Place voxels in any color with a variety of 3D shape tools like rectangles, cylinders, ramps, pyramids, etc. Import any image as custom standees. Detailed GM control over player vision, teams, dice, and more!
4842910.name: Terrablox

4845020.desc: 为了筹集妹妹高昂的学费，守财奴男主新海幸意外踏入了名为「人才租赁」的奇妙行当。在扮演男友、密友乃至情夫的虚假契约掩护下，少女们不为人知的隐秘欲望与真实心声悄然绽放。以金钱维系的脆弱羁绊终将遭遇现实的考验，当这层层伪装剥落时，究竟会是财尽缘散，还是假戏真做呢？一场充满谎言与心跳的青春恋爱喜剧就此上演。
4845020.name: 恋爱，我就借走咯

4850520.desc: Press any key on your keyboard to drive Skoot toward that key’s position in the arena. Dodge, ram, and outmaneuver opponents in fast-paced vehicular brawls built around your entire keyboard. Take on boss fights, Endless Mode, and online PvP as you brawl throughout Skoot’s strange futuristic worlds.
4850520.name: Skoot: Keyboard Brawl

4857910.desc: Join the Kabebutt Show, a wild TV game show where you bring your girl best friend for a shot at ¥500,000! Five women’s butts are in front of you, and one belongs to your best friend. Play with each girl, examine them through four intense rounds, and make sure you don't pick your bestie early!
4857910.name: Kabebutt Royale

4858370.desc: Real-time image-enhancement tool for any game. No mods required.
4858370.name: Dr Pixel

4858460.desc: A medieval free-for-all for 2–8 friends. Lead your army as a hero, raise your Castle, launch yourself from your own Mangonel and talk your way into alliances with proximity voice — then betray them. Outlast your rivals or top the final standings.
4858460.name: PARLEY

4859520.desc: "Smashboom" is a high-speed 3D competitive shooter where you deflect incoming projectiles and use feints to exploit your opponent's openings. Engage in tense mind games, unleash a surprise smash to catch your rival off guard, and take them down!
4859520.name: Smashboom

4859770.desc: Enjoy ColorByNumber in 3D voxel art. Match the numbers, paint the blocks, and create beautiful 3D artwork in this relaxing experience. Complete a variety of models, from cute animals to massive buildings, and unleash your creativity in Sandbox Mode!
4859770.name: CrystalCanvas

4861910.desc: Pin-Finite is a Roguelike deck-builder pinball game. Purchase unique and powerful upgrades to blow the lid on your points! Unlock rare pinballs and combos to scale your runs to infinity!
4861910.name: Pin-Finite

4863180.desc: Fast-Paced Tower Defense Game Where Space Is Used To Manipulate Enemy Behavior | Towers And Upgrades Take Up Space On The Board | Make The Enemy Decide Whether They Should Attack The Tower, Or Go Around!
4863180.name: Defend The HexCore

4866510.desc: A cat, synthwave music, and a single button to test your sense of rhythm. How hard could it be?
4866510.name: Purrfect Beats

4873800.desc: Solve rotating puzzles with cute cat girls. Cozy, soft-incremental gameplay. Chat With Cat Girls. Somehow Get Better at Puzzles. Make Questionable Choices. Unlock Surprisingly Useful Stuff.
4873800.name: Mosaique Neko Waifus 6

4876560.desc: A fast-paced Western cowboy duel game. Load your revolver, steady your breathing, and fire in the split second between life and death. Face off against friends in gunfights and challenge legendary cowboys from around the world; Earn bounties and become an undefeated legend of the Wild West.
4876560.name: Cowboy!Duel!

4876650.desc: Somewhere under that mountain of bricks is your floor. Sort the impossible Pile with a magnet glove, sieves, and part-seeking vision. Fill labeled drawers, pull parts, watch MOC builds snap together brick by brick. Cozy, satisfying, and governed by one rule: never sort by color.
4876650.name: Never Sort By Color

4877420.desc: Party up with your friends and explore a world of endless fun. Hang out in official rooms, discover community-created rooms, or create unforgettable memories with players from around the world.
4877420.name: Rec Room: A New Semester

4878180.desc: The Crazy Eights roguelike. Every 8 is wild: call the suit, keep the chain alive, and cash out monster combos. Build decks that bend the rules, stack House Rules that multiply each other, and break the casino one floor at a time.
4878180.name: Wild Crazy 8s

4878710.desc: 你将扮演一个被AI淘汰的程序员，回到那个停滞的小县城，与那个等了你十二年的女孩一起去寻找，从所有人记忆里消失的发小和尘封的往事，你们追查的不仅仅是真相，还是被AI一起困住的那个夏天、那座小城、那段永远不会结束的等待。
4878710.name: 知夏

4878900.desc: A satirical life-and-money sim. One turn is one month: budget your hours, work the job, ride the market, outlive inflation and your own decisions. Pick a character and make their dream come true. Or at least don't die trying.
4878900.name: Net Worthless

4879470.desc: Search a persistent hay pile with millions of candidates and one winning needle. Work strand by strand alone or with up to three friends, sort the mess, sell strange finds, and unlock better tools in a cozy first-person test of patience.
4879470.name: A Needle In a Haystack

4880820.desc: 《疾风群侠传》是一款武侠题材的多周目养成Roguelike游戏。在不断推进的江湖岁月中，自由修炼武学，加入风栖谷或凌霄门，踏上截然不同的门派道路。邂逅多位性格各异的红颜，在随机见闻、奇遇抉择与生死战斗中积累实力，探寻身世之谜，决定正邪立场，谱写独属于你的侠客传奇。
4880820.name: 疾风群侠传

4886710.desc: One mouse, One mushroom, No chackpoints.
4886710.name: Mushroom Must Go Up!

4887480.desc: A deep pro-football front-office sim. Draft through a fog of scouting, build contracts that come due years later, develop raw kids into stars, and outlast 31 rival GMs who scout, bluff, and hold grudges. No play-calling. Every decision is yours, and so is every consequence.
4887480.name: Gridiron Grit

4891760.desc: Summon and merge random heroes to create mightier heroes and fend off incoming waves of enemies! Upgrade your heroes and discover diverse relics to forge your ultimate build! It's time to conquer the Abyss!
4891760.name: Celeforge

489520.desc: An addictive fast-paced hybrid of Card games & Tower-Defense. Play 1v1 - or bring a friend for 2v2 - and engage in epic online multiplayer battles full of innovative strategy and awesome plays! Collect 200+ cards with unique mechanics, all free!
489520.name: Minion Masters

4898190.desc: Erevael is a fantasy RPG on a hex map that's different every game. There are no classes. You get better at whatever you do, from trading and mapmaking to magic and fighting. When your character retires, you carry on as their heir with their spells, recipes and maps.
4898190.name: Erevael

489830.desc: Winner of more than 200 Game of the Year Awards, The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition brings the epic fantasy to life in stunning detail. The Special Edition includes the critically acclaimed game and add-ons with all-new features.
489830.name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition

4900110.desc: Well, nice catch! You caught a mermaid with a tempting smile and she isn’t going to let you go that easily. Reel her closer, uncover the secrets of the deep and chase six endings: from sweet romance to something much darker.
4900110.name: Oops… I Hooked Up with a Mermaid 🎣😳

4901540.desc: Pick up a brick and build a little world. Follow the instructions, add stickers, and collect new models in this cozy brick-building game. Unwind on your own or grow your collection with friends.
4901540.name: Brick Buddies

4901860.desc: An arcade incremental where you ARE the tornado. Suck up cows, flatten cities, and spend the cash on upgrades between runs. Become fire, flood, winter or void. Start with a blade of grass. Tear Earth apart, then take your storm to an alien world. Raise cows on a farm of your own.
4901860.name: The Big Suck

4903020.desc: Upgrade, evolve, and mutate powerful spells as you defend the Last Spire in this strategic incremental tower defense with endless progression and customizable spell loadouts.
4903020.name: The Last Spire 2

4904730.desc: Click flies, unlock achievements, and complete your collection. A simple and satisfying clicker designed for achievement hunters.
4904730.name: Achievement Fly Clicker

4907430.desc: A thrilling Co-op Action Roguelite for 1-4 players! Play as mischievous ghosts, create insane weapon synergies, catch humans, and turn them into pumpkins. Deliver your harvest to the crypt, expand the map, and unleash vibrant chaos in this Bullet Heaven!
4907430.name: GrindFall

4908110.desc: Run a chaotic gas station sandbox: fuel cars, clean and repair vehicles, buy wild tools, catch wanted drivers, earn reviews, unlock upgrades, climb the leaderboard, or turn every stop into total mayhem.
4908110.name: Gas N Cars

4908560.desc: Setter is a volleyball management game where every decision shapes your club. Build and develop your squad in a competitive transfer market where rivals can bid for your players, prepare your lineup and tactics, and watch every rally unfold as you compete for domestic titles and continental success.
4908560.name: Setter: Volleyball Manager 27

4912740.desc: Bake, decorate, and serve beautiful cakes for customers celebrating life's special moments. Customize every order, expand your bakery with new ingredients and decorations, and create the coziest cake shop in town at your own relaxing pace.
4912740.name: Cake & Bake

4915700.desc: Ebbtide is a zombie survival strategy game. Lead the last carrier task force through a world overrun by the dead, starting in Los Angeles: direct your forces on a real-time operations map, then zoom straight into the 3D pixel-art battlefield to command the fight or take direct control.
4915700.name: Ebbtide

4915740.desc: Welcome to chichi’s world! Chichi is a little mouse with big travel dreams and just one piece of luggage: a ball! Keep chichi company while you work or study, play together, try new outfits and skins, or go online with friends and bring your mice together on your desktops.
4915740.name: Chichi's Desktop Journey

4917940.desc: Run a chaotic pub with your friends in online co-op! Serve drinks, cook food, and upgrade your bar — but keep your customers happy, or they might turn into bears and beat you up! As your pub grows, so does the chaos, with more customers, new cocktails, delicious dishes, and tougher nights!
4917940.name: Panic Pub

4920280.desc: Hang a battlefield on your desktop and let your soldier fight and grow automatically. Plan talents, buy gear, refine builds, and use APM to boost combat speed. Team up with friends for ranked battles, chase higher KDA and scores, and find out who is best at “strategic slacking” during work.
4920280.name: 喵呜风云

4921660.desc: Rank 5 words from S to D to fit the prompt, then everyone guesses the star's ranking in this online party game for 2–10 players. Perfect matches get cheers, wild misses get laughs!
4921660.name: EVERYONE'S TIER LIST!

4925810.desc: Build a global T20 dynasty across dozens of fictional competitions. Scout thousands of players, win auctions and transfers, develop youth, set fields and bowling plans, and watch every delivery resolve through a ball-by-ball match engine entirely offline.
4925810.name: Cricket Manager

4927420.desc: A pixel-art idle zombie RPG that lives in a slim strip above your taskbar. Your survivors fight the horde while you work: loot scrap, forge gear, unlock skills, prestige and push through 4 difficulties. Minimize the apocalypse - or go fullscreen when the boss arrives.
4927420.name: Idle of the Dead

4928450.desc: 1-4+ players time-travel kidnapping-collection dungeon-crawling heist with physics, guns, bosses, arena, homebase, skins, and stocks! Kidnap people across 200+ worlds of history & fiction, haul them home in cages and farm paradox in your garage. 25+ theme packs, 2,000+ NPCs and Workshop mods!
4928450.name: Grand Theft Timeline

4930190.desc: With the horde behind you and asphalt in front, there's only one choice. Drive or Die. An arcade roguelite about outrunning the apocalypse in a gun covered junker. Draft cards, chain kills, die, upgrade and go again.
4930190.name: Drive or Die

4932820.desc: An incremental game about flipping bottles, unlocking and upgrading unique abilities, and turning simple bottle flips into increasingly satisfying moments.
4932820.name: Bottle Flip Inc

4934200.desc: Extraction survivors-like meets ARPG loot, with deep crafting you'll understand in one click. Melt the horde, fill your bag, extract through the portal. Die and it goes with your character. Your next one levels up faster and skips floors you already beat. How deep do you dare go?
4934200.name: Extract Survivors

4934400.desc: GameLaunchSimulator is a text-based management sim about the full journey of publishing an indie game. Build your studio, plan new projects, prepare store pages, grow wishlists, handle reviews, release windows, publishing deals, and post-launch operations, then bring an unknown game to real players.
4934400.name: 游戏发行模拟器 Game Launch Simulator

4935280.desc: vim racer is a speed based training game that teaches real Vim motions by racing a block cursor through real source code, from h j k l all the way to search and bracket matching. There's no accuracy score, only speed, so the fastest path is always the correct one.
4935280.name: vim racer

4937900.desc: Investigate system failures, trace corrupted infrastructure, and keep the node alive before stability reaches zero. NODE ZERO is an interface-driven psychological horror game where something inside the system is learning how you work.
4937900.name: NODE ZERO

4938350.desc: Idol Lust is an idle strategy game combining strategy and RPG. As the manager of agency "LUCKY", you willl guide idols on stage and lead them to fight "U-Mutations" to protect New Tokyo!
4938350.name: Idol Lust

4940980.desc: Run a cozy ramen bar in a busy Japanese city. Prepare bowls, serve customers, and keep the place clean, all while expanding your menu every day. But when you're alone something doesn't feel quite right...
4940980.name: The Ramen Bar

4942010.desc: A game console you can walk into. Astrolobe OS is an orbital station with a desk of your own, original games including TERMINAL ORION, and a real desktop for work. Full controller support for most controllers out of the box in every game, plus 4-player split screen on games that support it.
4942010.name: Astrolobe OS

4943870.desc: To solidify the new Demon King's authority, violate the incoming heroes and broadcast their shameful, lust-broken submission for the entire world to see!
4943870.name: The Demon King's Reclusive Strategist

4943970.desc: Franchise Hockey Manager returns for the 2026-27 season with plenty of additions to the deepest, most authentic hockey strategy gaming experience you can find. Choose from teams around the globe and select a team to guide to glory, including a chance at the ultimate prize, the Stanley Cup®.
4943970.name: Franchise Hockey Manager 13

4946440.desc: A physics sandbox about Murray, who didn't let a witch merge onto the highway. She sent him to The Granule, and something already lives there. You. Burn, freeze, shock, slice, and mend him. None of it is scripted, and the room is not all there is.
4946440.name: Granule

4946550.desc: A short, satisfying incremental game about breaking blocks. Destroy blocks, unlock new tools and upgrades, and break even more blocks.
4946550.name: Deblock

4947250.desc: Build and run your own kebab restaurant in a single-player management simulation. Set prices, hire staff, serve customers, keep the shop clean, upgrade the interior, and turn a small counter into a thriving food business.
4947250.name: Kebab Dynasty

4948250.desc: A cozy pixel cat companion for your desktop: it lives on top of your windows while you work or study. Feed it, play with it, dress it up, and watch its character emerge: it remembers your care, sulks if woken, and hunts its toys.
4948250.name: Purrtopia

4948940.desc: Swarmbreaker is an incremental tower defense game where you must defend your base from a giant living wave of alien bugs. Build defenses to block their path, deploy heavy weapons, upgrade your arsenal, and break the swarm!
4948940.name: Swarmbreaker

4949400.desc: MY CAT SCATTERED GAMES is a tidy up organizing game. Put 5,158 games and consoles back on the shelves, restore your video game store, and free your mischievous cat from the claw machine. Play by yourself or with up to 3 friends in co-op!
4949400.name: MY CAT SCATTERED GAMES: Tidy Videogame Supermarket

4951630.desc: Ride your own music. Soundway transforms any song into a neon roller coaster racing through deep space, with every burst of speed, climb, drop, and turn shaped by the track itself. Catch the beat, build massive combos, dodge hazards, and chase the music across the stars.
4951630.name: Soundway

4951770.desc: The space beyond each door changes depending on the word you create by arranging Panels. Use your creativity to discover the words that will lead you out of the building in this insight-driven puzzle game.
4951770.name: Door Code

4951820.desc: An emotionally charged kinetic visual novel about Hana, an aspiring actress whose relationships and career are slipping through her fingers - until a sudden transformation into a futanari throws her life into chaos and forces her to confront everything she thought she knew.
4951820.name: More Than  A Woman - Season 1

49520.desc: The Ultimate Vault Hunter’s Upgrade lets you get the most out of the Borderlands 2 experience.
49520.name: Borderlands 2

4954910.desc: Run a scam call center with your friends. Use increasingly ridiculous schemes to trick AI callers out of their life savings. Hit your daily quota, cause chaos around the office, and survive a brutal performance review from your rageaholic boss.
4954910.name: Scam With Your Friends

4954970.desc: One of you is the cop. The rest are panicked suspects. Hide the body, clean up the evidence, don’t rat each other out, and get rid of everything before your cop friend knocks on the door. There is only one rule: if the body is found, you’re all done for.
4954970.name: No Body No Problem!

4955600.desc: A vertical-climbing action roguelike: scale a massive tower as a capybara while your weapons fire on their own, bullet-heaven style. Level up, shape your build, take on quests, and unlock weapons and characters. Every run generates a brand-new tower.
4955600.name: Capy of Gods

4955730.desc: Step into the shoes of Travis, the internet's favorite plumbing vigilante! Explore procedurally generated levels, test public faucets for the perfect flow, and evade city security in this endless, meme-inspired arcade stealth game powered by Unreal Engine 5.7.
4955730.name: Public Faucet Hunt

4955970.desc: Restore the lost history of the Mesozoic in an atmospheric idle game. Grow a branching discovery tree, uncover dinosaurs and vanished ecosystems, complete an illustrated scientific Codex, and rebuild the Triassic, Jurassic, and Cretaceous.
4955970.name: Epoch Vault

4956460.desc: A happy North American neighborhood awaits you! Play solo or with up to 9 friends. Build your crew, take on jobs around the neighborhood, earn money and buy houses. Create your own cash flow and happily build your real estate empire!
4956460.name: AMERICAN LIFE SIMULATOR

4957380.desc: Build a political party in a fictional country and play for one thing: win power and keep it. Recruit politicians, conquer regions, win elections. There are clean paths and dirty games. Everyone has a price. What's yours?
4957380.name: Demockracy

4959060.desc: A 2D mining game about digging your way off a dead planet. Drill deep for rare ores, dodge lava and gas pockets, upgrade your rig, then pool your haul with friends to smelt bars, craft parts, and build the rocket that gets your crew home. Solo or 1–16 players.
4959060.name: Legacy Miner

4960640.desc: KIT Three Kingdoms: Heroes at War is a logistics-driven strategy game. Govern cities, recruit officers and move armies across a grand map, then command formations, Battle Arts, Stratagems, sieges and duels in real time. Choose a faction in seven sandbox starts and unite the realm.
4960640.name: KIT Three Kingdoms: Heroes at War

4960970.desc: A dark romance SRPG. Pledge your life to feisty and unhinged monstergirls, then defeat your foes using careful positioning and strategical wit. From the downtrodden rise a revolting mafia; join them in a wild hunt for power, revenge, change... and love.
4960970.name: Monster Girl Tactics: Oubliette

4961250.desc: You are the prince of a small kingdom. Defend its castles from monsters in this tower defense game!
4961250.name: The Rookie Prince's Defense Trials

4965130.desc: A shooter / gem collection game that lives in your files. Corridors combines high-score action with a fully functional, intuitive file and media explorer. Play in our preset world for competition, or turn your PC and its files into the setting. Lightweight, portable, runs native on most systems.
4965130.name: Corridors

4970630.desc: Fill a giant 5,000,000-liter jar in the valley! Harvest your first honeycomb by hand, lay hose networks, and scale up to 10,000 liters/sec with drones and full automation. Unlock 200+ upgrades, play guitar on your farm, and uncover the jar's secret in this cozy 8-10 hour journey!
4970630.name: Beellionaire Incremental: Bee Simulator

4970750.desc: What would you say to a goblin if you could speak to it in your own words? Bribe it, lie to it, threaten it... or just chop its head off. Warrior Quest is an old-school dark-fantasy dungeon crawler where you can fight, sneak, bluff, or bargain your way through. Whatever you do, roll well!
4970750.name: Warrior Quest

4971410.desc: A multiplayer bullet hell where everyone is a tank.
4971410.name: Tankii
