5308680.desc: A cheerful supermarket game for kids ages 3–6. Shop with animal friends, scan groceries, count coins and enjoy 12 playful mini-games. Collect stickers and decorate your little store, with picture shopping lists and friendly voice prompts.
5308680.name: Little Supermarket

5311120.desc: A free adventure idle single-player hero game where you defeat enemies, collect treasures, challenge dungeon bosses, enhance equipment, and forge your own combat style. With hundreds of talents to choose from, Please note that it is entirely in Chinese and not in English
5311120.name: Treasure Hunt Dungeon

5311340.desc: A single-player card puzzle for five-minute sittings. Seat nobles, priests, soldiers, and peasants by each house's own rule, bank your chains before an event can break them, and satisfy all four houses to win the day. A fresh Daily Court is dealt to every player, every day.
5311340.name: Royal Court

5312680.desc: France, 1940. Follow a Polish-Jewish family as the Nazi occupation transforms their lives. Experience their story through the choices, struggles, and everyday moments that reveal the human cost of the Holocaust. A free narrative game.
5312680.name: The Light in the Darkness: Director's Cut

5312920.desc: Take charge of your very own local trading card shop! Order booster packs, hunt for ultra-rare foils, design your store layout, and set market prices. Rip packs to display holy grail singles or sell sealed boxes to build the ultimate card collector's paradise.
5312920.name: TCG Card Market Simulator

5312950.desc: You are the keeper of a lighthouse on a frozen northern island. Keep the lamp lit, the stove fed and the car fueled. And when the storm comes, don't step out where the light can't reach: a wendigo walks the island at night. And it is listening.
5312950.name: Lightkeeper: Frozen Bay

5318580.desc: "Jyoka" is a 16th-century Japanese castle town builder. Develop your territory with 190+ facilities and grant rice fields to retainers to secure loyalty. Defend against bandits and daimyos. Once stable, launch epic sieges against 70+ real-inspired castles to unify Japan!
5318580.name: Jyoka -Castle town-

5321440.desc: Everyone Lola meets wants her, and she has no idea why. Follow her on a wild adventure to uncover the mystery, with plenty of sex along the way!
5321440.name: Lola's Adventures

532210.desc: After a tragic incident, brothers Sean and Daniel Diaz run away from home. Fearing the police, and dealing with Daniel's new telekinetic power, the boys head to Mexico. Each stop on their journey brings new friends and new challenges.
532210.name: Life is Strange 2

5323250.desc: Starfall Defense is a real-time multiplayer tower defense game blending ancient mythology with cosmic sci-fi. Deploy legendary heroes like Pangu and Nuwa, trigger class synergies, and fend off alien swarms! Features 2-player co-op and ranked PvP. Free to play, pure strategy!
5323250.name: Starfall Defense

5323500.desc: DEEP SEAL is a 1–4 player co-op underwater horror game. Dive into dark, labyrinthine caves to recover bodies, find your way through the depths, and avoid the shark that's always hunting you. Grab what you can, find your teammates, and swim back alive.
5323500.name: DEEP SEAL

5324880.name: PICK A BOO Skin "Headphones with Ears"

5324990.name: PICK A BOO Skin "8-Bit Sunglasses + Necklace"

5325220.desc: Create a human or animal avatar that lives on your desktop. Dress them up, let them keep you company while you work or listen to music, use them as a VTube Avatar or send them to a friend’s screen with a wave, a hug or a little gift. Free to play forever to spread the warmth.
5325220.name: DeskHugs: Desktop Friends

5325790.desc: Don't Blow UP! brings minesweeper into first person, solo or in co-op for up to 4 players. Dig up tiles, flag mines, and face seven rule-twisting modifiers. One wrong choice can blow everything up.
5325790.name: Don't Blow UP!

5326270.desc: The fully original soundtrack of Dawn Aerowar, composed to picture by Jose Pavli. The music is orchestral, epic and fast-paced, with choirs, Bulgarian voices, classical guitar and the two original songs of the film. It comes as MP3, with lossless FLAC as an optional download.
5326270.name: DAWN AEROWAR Original Soundtrack

5326470.desc: Three thousand pieces of clothing just hit the floor. Iron out every crease, fold each one by hand, and file it back where it belongs. A cosy first-person tidying game that slowly automates your own ritual. Invite some friends to help, up to 8 players!
5326470.name: Walk-In: Fold It Together

5326850.desc: Build your own record label from the ground up, release music, grow your reputation, expand into global markets, and turn a small music business into a worldwide empire. Manage your catalog, discover opportunities, and make the decisions that shape your success.
5326850.name: Music Empire Tycoon

5330310.desc: Run a blood powered console company through 13 weeks of investors, scandals, negotiations, layoffs, promises, crises, and increasingly terrible business decisions. Keep the board happy. Keep Shawarma happy... Keep the customers quiet. Keep your job?
5330310.name: Shawarma Karma

5332990.desc: A night atlas you draw roads across. Link towns, untangle jams with junctions and highways, throw bridges, run ferries and air links. Four worlds — from a 16-area island to a map of 120 — and a new map every day.
5332990.name: Roadweave

5333020.desc: Six new heroes, new Equipment and 15 Version Rules join Esports Godfather. Hunt isolated targets, build up to a decisive execution or bring the Final Fight forward. Create new lineups and Hero Card combinations, and find your winning strategy as the meta changes.
5333020.name: The expansion pack 3 of 'Esports Godfather'

5333560.desc: Ribbit Racing is a multiplayer racing game where you play as a frog on a bike. Race up to 4 players locally or 8 online. Use your tongue, your wits, and the track to win.
5333560.name: Ribbit Racing

5334110.desc: Run a parcel inspection desk. Weigh, X-ray and look up every shipment, compare it with the declaration and the latest regulations, then stamp and route it: approve, return, hold, confiscate or dispose. Earn cash, upgrade your workplace and keep up with a growing quota.
5334110.name: Parcel Inspector Simulator

5335100.desc: It's Halloween night. The parents are out until midnight, and you're the babysitter. All you have to do is keep the porch light on and hand out candy.
5335100.name: Halloween 2026

5335510.desc: An entire Moon to clean. One toothbrush to start. Team up with up to 16 players, collect and sell lunar dust, upgrade your tools, and unlock cleaning vehicles. Turn a ridiculous job into a thriving operation, if your friends actually help.
5335510.name: Moon Sweepers

5342780.desc: A catgirl who lives in a cardboard box on your taskbar. Leave your PC too long and she pops out, knocks on your screen and nags you back to work. Pet her, pick her up by the scruff, teach her your own lines. Launches with a second character: Naiwa, the belly-laughing frog. Free to play.
5342780.name: 喵～该工作啦！ Nya! Back to Work

5343400.desc: A first person car flipping game. Find cheap used cars on your phone, on the side of the road or at storage auctions, and inspect them yourself. Fix what a buyer will notice, then sell them on, rent them out or race them for pink slips. Play solo or with up to three friends online.
5343400.name: Car Flipper

5345780.desc: A flirty match-3 puzzle game with 10 distinct characters and 99 levels. Pop bubbles, break heart locks and ice, and master new chapter mechanics as expressions and vocal reactions heat up with your combos. Match gems. Catch feelings.
5345780.name: BlockBabe

5351930.desc: Why wait for heroes to come for you? Build and deploy a monster army to eliminate them before they grow strong enough to defeat you. A strategy roguelite from the Demon Lord’s perspective!
5351930.name: Against Heroes

5352470.desc: Bring the greatest sport in the world to your Twitch stream with Corgi Race Live! Stream corgi races and have your chat compete with you; picking winners, exactas and trifectas with hopes of topping the leaderboard. Take on the mantle of corgi racing host and bring everyone to the party.
5352470.name: Corgi Race Live

5353720.desc: Customize your mouse cursor with 500 unique styles and give it a trail. 352 trails: comets, dragons, fireflies, a pet that naps by your pointer. Tune genes in the Lab or splice two trails into new ones. Featherweight and click-through, with no hooks or injection, on Windows 10 and 11.
5353720.name: MorphTrail

5353910.desc: One tree. An entire ecosystem to grow. Build your defenses, unleash spores and summoned allies, and survive relentless waves of pests in this incremental defense game. Earn permanent upgrades and help the last tree grow stronger with every cycle.
5353910.name: The Last Tree

5356510.desc: Fight through intense FPS operations alongside the X-Dolls. Complete objectives, upgrade your weapons and abilities, hunt secrets, eliminate powerful bosses, and survive a campaign across hostile locations filled with supernatural threats and deadly enemies.
5356510.name: X-Dolls Squad

5356830.desc: A wild 1980s crime adventure where dating, dirty jobs, drag races, shootouts, and adult fun collide. Explore the city, make money, build relationships, and cause trouble as you work your way toward the biggest score of your life.
5356830.name: GRAND TIDDY ADVENTURES 🚨

5367060.desc: This pack expands your Storage space and lets you organize items into separate tabs.
5367060.name: DPS - Storage Pack

5367070.desc: This pack is for players who want to support the development team.
5367070.name: DPS - Supporter Pack

5367460.desc: A Windows app that reads game subtitles and interface text in a selected screen area and translates them in place. Choose from offline-capable local models covering up to 100 languages, with stable subtitle overlays and a customizable glass-style display.
5367460.name: Real-Time Screen Translator

5369020.desc: 3D isometric open-world Action/Shooter. The city, devastated by a nuclear explosion, was seized by hostile factions. The main character, together with his ranger friend, decides to restore order and free it from the chaos.
5369020.name: The Last UNION

5369070.desc: Buy lost suitcases from flights around the world, crack them open and see what is inside: socks, cameras, gold bricks or a rubber duck. Sell every find on the baggage belt and grow your dusty garage into an automated luggage business.
5369070.name: Lost Luggage

5371810.desc: Cozy Tent is a quiet, single-player ambience game. Stay inside a tent in the forest while the rain falls: make a hot drink, read, play chess, watch a sky that follows the real clock and moon, and share the tent with a ferret.
5371810.name: Cozy Tent

5373210.desc: Build roads, intersections, and tram lines. The city grows on its own along the roads you lay. Ease congestion and turn a village into a metropolis.
5373210.name: Arteria

5373260.desc: Sound in liquid form. Ferro is a real-time 3D audio-reactive fluid simulation. Shape liquid, light and motion with music, MIDI, automation, or even your microphone. Infinitely customizable, place on your desktop or add to your livestream for an expressive companion to your sound.
5373260.name: Ferro - 3D Audio Visualizer

5373430.desc: ATELIER BLOCKS is a falling-block puzzle game built around customization, creation, and multiple ways to play. It features 18 single-player rule sets, nine AI battle rule sets, cute minigames, and five Creation Studios.
5373430.name: ATELIER BLOCKS

5374820.desc: Chopper, the jester executioner wielding giant shears, joins your squad! Meet a new melee damage dealer who slices through enemies by switching between combat stances.
5374820.name: DPS - Character Pack : Chopper

5375170.desc: Cozy, short and relaxing: cast your net to clean up a dirty lake and bring nature back. With dogs as helpers, recycle trash and earn money to upgrade your gear. Lots of hidden treasures to find and wash, in a satisfying mini-game to decorate your house. Wildlife appreciates your work.
5375170.name: My Dirty Little Lake

5375410.desc: Link Loop is a 2D puzzle platformer built around portals and satisfying physics. Use portals to move objects, redirect lasers, and transport fluids. Levels have multiple solutions, and creativity is key.
5375410.name: Link Loop

5375770.desc: Become the last Reaper in a brutal dark fantasy action game featuring precision sword combat, reactive enemy AI, advanced gore physics, and devastating supernatural abilities. Master deadly encounters, command, and unleash carnage across endless waves of enemies.
5375770.name: Mox Nox

5375890.desc: Turn a chaotic dice shop into a satisfying collection. Pick up, inspect and sort 4,095 colorful dice into matching sets, fill wooden shelves and unlock handy upgrades in this cozy first-person organizing game.
5375890.name: Sort Them Dice

5376970.desc: Turn a small backyard into a farm that supplies an entire town. Grow crops, make goods, deliver orders and expand your business — solo or in co-op with up to 4 players.
5376970.name: Farm Business Simulator

5377410.desc: Defend your throne against undead hordes in a pixel-art siege roguelite. Aim your attacks without leaving your seat, hunt legendary gear, and combine seven schools of power. Turn your spoils into permanent kingdom upgrades. The king will not survive the siege. His gold will.
5377410.name: King Dies Rich

5378030.desc: A Napoleonic-era Roguelite Tower Defense. Lead the defense of the Wall against the hordes of the apocalypse. Command the united armies of Europe, deploy living lines of defense, map out range cards, and halt tens of thousands of enemies. Ready! Present! Fire! Commander, win humanity one more dawn.
5378030.name: La Muraille 1806

5378110.desc: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower, solo or online co-op up to 6 players. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding.
5378110.name: One More Lawn

5378180.desc: Free 4K pack for Dawn. It adds the whole film in 2160p and 10-bit colour, with the film grain intact. The download is optional, about 20 GB, and you pick it in the player's settings. You need the film to use it.
5378180.name: DAWN AEROWAR - Pack 4K

5379520.desc: A knockout party game for 1–8 friends online. 69 minigames of reflexes, memory, aim and nerve, each explained in one line. Everyone plays the same level at the same time. Fail, or come last, and you're out. First to 100 points is the smartest in the room.
5379520.name: Smartest in the Room

5379640.desc: Aim for the head as zombies close in through darkness and fear. Earn gold, unlock permanent upgrades, and survive escalating waves of special infected and bosses in this 2D pixel survival shooter. Choose upgrades carefully, control the horde, and push for a higher score in every short run.
5379640.name: HEADSHOT: Zombie Doomsday

5380110.desc: Peekour is a 2D pixel art platformer. YOU desperately need to pee and only the final toilet counts! Run, jump and parkour through 6+ levels. Collect coins and bottles of water to get more pee, and customize your experience with 40+ skins.
5380110.name: Peekour

5380650.desc: Retro arcade action meets glowing 3D voxels in this twin-stick arena shooter. Dodge bullets, shatter enemy ships and turn wreckage into upgrades. Build your ship across five sectors, then push further in Overdrive and Endless mode.
5380650.name: VOXFRAG

5381000.desc: A simple management game at the bottom of your desktop. Assign dwarves to gather, craft, research, and trade. Pay gold to Snow White, a fearsome dragon, every ten years and guide your settlement through a hundred-year fairy tale.
5381000.name: Snow White and the Dwarf Slaves

5381260.desc: Terrum DeepDrill is a single-player drilling game in a 2.5D side view. Terrum Corp owns your debt and calls it a contract. Win tenders against rival firms, drill through the rock, and haul enough ore to stay ahead of the bill.
5381260.name: Terrum DeepDrill

5383190.desc: Team up with up to 3 players and tackle parkour courses in a town swallowed by water! Take on the Sunken Bloom and Drowned Wastes maps, overcome obstacles, create chaos with your cars, and choose between collision-free or collision-enabled gameplay with the Immunity feature!
5383190.name: Car Parkour 4 Together

5386810.desc: Your first night shift in a police evidence archive nobody has filed in years. Pick up loose papers, photos and tapes, uncover hidden case numbers with the right tool, then press, stamp, box and shelve each case. No clock, no quota, no way to fail.
5386810.name: Evidence Vault

5389200.desc: An online space-mining idle incremental game that lives in the corner of your screen. Mine alongside other pilots, unlock automatic mining, upgrade your ship, and build your own orbital station while you work or browse.
5389200.name: Asteroid Watch

5389650.desc: EVO RNG is slot-machine god-game - draft creatures, press spin and watch your ecosystem hunt, merge and evolve on its own. Collect, chase paylines, food chains and mythic creatures. Game does not contain any real money gambling elements.
5389650.name: EVO RNG

5390550.desc: A beautiful married woman moves in next door. One day, while her husband is away, she makes a bold move on you. Unable to resist her sweet temptation, you begin a secret affair filled with forbidden pleasure. A sweet and naughty relationship begins whenever her husband is away...
5390550.name: The Wife Next Door - She Drains Me While Her Husband's Away

5391250.desc: Chaos in the wizard's shop? An army of knights at the inn? Tidy Up Ltd. is on the job! Pick up wares, sweep away dust and put furniture where it belongs. Play cozy co-op for 1 to 8 players, from a little shop to a huge academy of magic.
5391250.name: Tidy Up Ltd.: A Cozy Co-op Cleanup

5391510.desc: Learn game theory optimal (GTO) poker five minutes a day. Tea Break deals you a hand, a seat and a decision, grades your answer against solver output, and tells you which idea a mistake broke. A study tool for No Limit cash Hold'em, not a poker game: no real money, no wagering.
5391510.name: Tea Break Poker Trainer

5394070.desc: A short horror cooking game. Run your dead uncle's burger cart on a foggy harbour pier in the 1970s. Cook for the locals, spot the drowned before they reach your window, and find out who really killed your uncle.
5394070.name: The Usual, Please

5395030.desc: Every hero summoned to this world got an amazing skill. You got [Idle]: you only get stronger while doing absolutely nothing. Your party fights the Demon Lord's armies. You nap under a tree and collect all the EXP. An idle comedy that plays better when you're not playing it.
5395030.name: I Was Reincarnated with the [Idle] Skill, and Now I Do Nothing

5395920.desc: Bring order to a shop overflowing with collectible frogs. Pick up and sort colorful figures, fill themed shelves, unlock helpful upgrades, and search for hidden eggs. Build your collection one frog at a time.
5395920.name: Frog Collector

5396440.desc: Poke, stretch and fling your squishy jelly! Every texture feels different. Then trap rivals with jelly bombs — pang-pang! Stages 1–15 are free; the Full Version Unlock DLC adds 16–50.
5396440.name: Pop! Jelly PangPang

5397370.desc: Great things grow stronger together! Backed by TRENTILA, Alliance wants to turn teamwork into triumph at The Grand Major 2026. Show your allegiance with their official team bundle!
5397370.name: THE FINALS - Alliance TGM26

5397380.desc: Ape Squad is ready to go bananas at The Grand Major 2026! Show you support them with their official team collection. VAIIYA’s backing this monkey business!
5397380.name: THE FINALS - Ape Squad TGM26

5397390.desc: Elevate is ready to raise the bar at The Grand Major 2026! And with ALFA ACTA backing them, you can bet they've got a contingency plan for every possible outcome. Show your support with their official collection!
5397390.name: THE FINALS - Elevate TGM26

5397400.desc: ENVY is heading to The Grand Major 2026, and they're planning to give the competition plenty to be jealous of! Show your support with their official team collection, backed by HYDRA-Q.
5397400.name: THE FINALS - ENVY TGM26

5397410.desc: Five Fears is ready to spread some serious fright in The Grand Major 2026! Support the team with their official collection, powered by OSPUZE. The competition has been warned.
5397410.name: THE FINALS - Five Fears TGM26

5397420.desc: Where there's smoke, there's FYR! This squad's ready to turn up the heat at The Grand Major 2026, with VOLPE fueling the flames. Show your support with their official team collection!
5397420.name: THE FINALS - FYR TGM26

5397430.desc: The Kansas City Pioneers are blazing a trail to The Grand Major 2026! With ALFA ACTA behind them, you can bet they've come properly prepared. Show your support with their official team collection!
5397430.name: THE FINALS - KCP TGM26

5397440.desc: KingZero isn't here to count the seconds in The Grand Major 2026. They're here to make every moment count! Rep them with their OSPUZE-powered collection.
5397440.name: THE FINALS - KingZero TGM26

5397450.desc: Luminon is looking to light up The Grand Major 2026. They’re backed by HOLTOW, so at least someone's insured! Show your support with their official team collection.
5397450.name: THE FINALS - Luminon TGM26

5397460.desc: Moon Theory has an interesting theory about who should take the crown at The Grand Major 2026. Rep the team with their official collection, brought to you by VAIIYA!
5397460.name: THE FINALS - Moon Theory TGM26

5397470.desc: No limits. No looking back. Nfinite is heading to The Grand Major 2026 with HYDRA-Q in their corner and their sights set on the crown. Show your support with the team's official team collection!
5397470.name: THE FINALS - Nfinite TGM26

5397480.desc: Many teams dream of winning The Grand Major 2026. NTMR is here to ruin those dreams! Get behind the squad with an official collection, brought to you by VOLPE!
5397480.name: THE FINALS - NTMR TGM26

5397490.desc: Things are about to get RAD at The Grand Major 2026! With DISSUN supplying the power, this squad is ready to turn up the heat. Show your support with their official team collection!
5397490.name: THE FINALS - RAD TGM26

5397500.desc: Fasten your seatbelts! Take Flyte is heading for The Grand Major 2026, and HOLTOW has them covered. Rep the team with their official collection!
5397500.name: THE FINALS - Take Flyte TGM26

5397520.desc: Vanguard Gaming is charging into Grand Major 2026 with their sights on the top of the bracket! Powered by DISSUN, this official team collection is ready to bring some serious competitive energy to your Arena loadout.
5397520.name: THE FINALS - Vanguard TGM26

5398160.desc: Gopher It is a cozy first-person job sim about being the newest intern in an office full of animals. When someone calls, you go and do what they want: copies, coffee, the post, a birthday card to pass round. Play solo or with up to three friends. No timers, no game over.
5398160.name: Gopher It: Office Intern Simulator

5398370.desc: A unique roguelike word fusing mutant breeding game! Fuse the monsters and the words into one creature. Form an army of mutants and battle the world! Or play with a friend and fuse parts together.
5398370.name: Battlegenics

5399970.desc: Air Support is a top-down arcade helicopter shooter in a world of plastic toy soldiers. Fly a Green Army gunship over backyard battlefields, blast the Tan Army, winch up cargo, and bring a friend in co-op.
5399970.name: Plastic Soldiers: Air Support

5401670.desc: Christmas is coming and the toy warehouse is a mess! Read the kids’ letters, find the right toys, pack them and pull the lever. But be careful! Some kids don’t deserve toys, and the coal crate is right there!
5401670.name: Toys, Please!

5401760.desc: 4,600 spells are scattered across the floor, and they're all yours to put away. Shelve each one in its element's cabinet, then fuse two elements together to create a spell no one has seen before.
5401760.name: Tidy Up the Magic Mess

5402730.desc: Awaken your power in Core Awakened, a 2D fighting game without a traditional health bar. Charge your energy, master CORE I, II and III, and unleash combos and special finishers. Play Arcade, challenge a friend locally or fight other players online through Steam.
5402730.name: Core Awakened

5403100.desc: This pack reduces repetitive tasks and lets you quickly switch between Gear and Skill setups.
5403100.name: DPS - Convenience Pack

5403380.desc: Your little brother mashed your toy bricks into ugly lumps and left them on your desk. Pull them apart, sort every piece into the bin with its picture, then follow a booklet whose steps play like little videos and build something lovely. Just one more piece...
5403380.name: One More Piece

5403780.desc: A first-person party brawler for up to 20 players! Punch rivals out of crumbling arenas or launch them into goals with wacky weapons. Play every mode solo against AI, or invite Steam friends. Multiplayer starts with 2 human players, with AI filling empty slots.
5403780.name: Punch Riot

5403800.desc: A cozy gold panning game. Wash the creek gravel, watch the gold settle in your pan, sell your finds in the village, and turn a small empty room into a home. No timers, no failure. Just quiet, golden little days.
5403800.name: Golden Pan

5404040.desc: Sneak past the guards, use the map gimmicks, and open every locked door. 14 beauties are waiting on the other side — with an animated scene to match. 30 stages. 30 adult animations.
5404040.name: Lewd Life

5404190.desc: A touch-based puzzle simulation game. A woman has been strapped to a new type of bomb, and her heart rate is linked to its trigger. Remove the restraints and tasks across her body, make her climax, and defuse the bomb. Features animated scenes and 2 endings.
5404190.name: Bomb Disposal

5404460.desc: A cozy first-person tidying game. Thousands of board game boxes lie scattered across a charming two-storey shop. Gather stacks of copies, shelve every game in its category and watch the shop come back to life, one satisfying section at a time.
5404460.name: The Cozy Board Game Shop: Tidy Up

5405270.desc: Słownikowa Wyspa is a Polish-language educational adventure game. Join Mizuki on a journey across a mysterious island, solve word puzzles, explore unique locations, collect missing book pages, and discover fascinating facts in an illustrated encyclopedia.
5405270.name: Słownikowa Wyspa

5405460.desc: A digital comic set in the Beholder universe, presented as a handbook for the ever-watchful landlord. Discover the fine art of minding everyone else's business through dark humor, suspicious tenants, and the absurd rules of the Great State that never stops watching.
5405460.name: Beholder: The Landlord's Handbook - Digital Comic

5405820.desc: A red-hooded archer, a silver moon bow and a horde that never runs out. Moonbow Idle is a dark fantasy auto battler: leave it on a second monitor or sit down and min-max. Hatch pets, farm boss gear, ascend, go deeper.
5405820.name: Moonbow Idle: Dark Fantasy Auto Battler

5408770.desc: Walter Kessler works the night shift at a data center that is always quiet, always cold, and never quite right. Five nights of first-person psychological horror: clear the alerts, walk the halls, answer the radio, and make it to six.
5408770.name: 5 Nights at Data Center

5409100.desc: Enter twelve cursed chambers in a gothic survival game where weapons attack automatically and movement keeps you alive. Discover 100 weapons with no equipment limit, face increasingly difficult levels and bosses, and descend deeper into darkness. (Not a roguelike)
5409100.name: The 12 Chambers of Darkness

5409410.desc: Tidy up to 19,026 objects across a two-floor store with 25 departments. Pick up products, restock shelves, fold clothes and earn upgrades in this cozy first-person tidying game. Play solo or team up in online co-op with up to 4 players.
5409410.name: Mart: Tidy Up Together

5411310.desc: Smash crates as Tin, a tiny salvage robot with a hammer, and free the memories locked inside ten vaults. A handful of crates grows into total havoc of lightning, saw blades and drones in this 5–7 hour incremental game with a real ending.
5411310.name: Tiny Havoc

5411460.desc: Run a restaurant as inflatable cooks! Chop, stir and serve before your balloon guests swell with rage and pop. Don't overinflate, dodge the knives, patch holes with tape, and build new rooms and machines. Co-op chaos for 1–4 players, online or on one screen.
5411460.name: Overinflated

5412000.desc: Play Solitaire. Move cards, undo a move, start a new deal, or check the in-game guide at your own pace. Then Explore DLCs. العب سوليتير بنظام سحب بطاقة واحدة. يمكنك نقل البطاقات، والتراجع عن خطوة، وبدء جولة جديدة، أو الرجوع إلى دليل اللعبة وبالسرعة التي تناسبك. ثم إستكشف الألعاب الأخرى.
5412000.name: Jibtik - جبتك

5415560.desc: Eat your way through an entire supermarket! Start with snacks, earn money from everything you eat, and buy upgrades to eat faster and devour bigger things. Go from a bag of chips to entire shelves, fridges and even the checkouts. Can you eat the whole store?
5415560.name: Eat Everything in a Supermarket

5416020.desc: Mythistoria is an all-in-one creative writing and world-building application built for novelists and storytellers alike to manage their process end-to-end.
5416020.name: Mythistoria

5418360.desc: Finally, touch grass. Comb a hill of grass with your mouse, pick flowers, catch fireflies and wait for rare visitors, from a frog to a dragon at night. Or make the hill your live desktop wallpaper. Free, relaxing and impressively unproductive. The grass can wait.
5418360.name: Touch Grass, Pls!

5418900.desc: The echoes of a forgotten kingdom await. This is the official Thronefall soundtrack, with music from the base game and the Craaghelm DLC. Strings by day, drums by night. To hear, you only have to listen.
5418900.name: Thronefall Soundtrack

5419120.desc: Santa crashed his sleigh into your garden and Christmas is buried under the snow. Call up to three friends and dig it all out: sell the snow, upgrade from bare cookie hands to absurd machines, and bury each other along the way. Cozy, chaotic co-op with proximity voice chat.
5419120.name: Snow Worries!

5420690.desc: This is an online RPG featuring a retro fantasy aesthetic. Starting from Talking Island, you can play as a Knight or a Wizard, exploring villages, wilderness areas, and underground dungeons. Engage in real-time combat to hunt monsters and gather loot as you gradually develop your character.
5420690.name: 天堂世族網路遊戲 (Royal Lineage Online)

5421150.desc: BIG CLIMB is a co-op climbing game for 1-4 players tied by a real physical rope. Climb the mountain together before the colossal spider gets the one lagging behind.
5421150.name: Big Climb

5423880.desc: You’re trapped in a room with a thousand fingers. Press them, gather supplies and try to survive the consequences. Experiment and find a way out solo or with friends—up to four players. In PvP, grab a weapon and fight free-for-all or two against two.
5423880.name: Don't Press This SH*T

5424890.desc: This is a video game based on the Backrooms myth, but it breaks away from its lore to tell an original story. It features a variety of gameplay sections with different creatures and a narrative-driven approach that sets it apart from other games based on these locations.
5424890.name: Backrooms: 1977

5425210.desc: Explore the maze. Collect the gems. Uncover its secrets. Dungeon Escape 3 is a 2D top-down maze escape game featuring over 30 levels to explore, hidden collectibles to discover, and puzzles to solve. Navigate through a maze of interconnected rooms, unlock new paths, and see how far you can go.
5425210.name: Dungeon Escape 3

5427110.desc: Lost Bitcoin is a digging and automation game set in a gigantic junkyard. Collect scrap, burn it for coins, buy upgrades and build a factory that works for you. Crack crates and safes, and check every USB stick to find your lost Bitcoin wallet.
5427110.name: Lost Bitcoin

5427130.desc: Upwardly is a colorful 3D precision platformer. Climb 10 castles across 5,000 meters, dodge deadly hazards, and race the clock. Choose from three difficulty modes, master every jump, and chase your personal best on randomized or shareable seeded courses.
5427130.name: Upwardly

5431930.desc: In 1980, Dad left a small vintage shop and 300 yuan. You took the counter and rang the bell. Ice lollies, enamel mugs, frog sunglasses, Yanwu tape recorders filled the shelves. Seventy antiques, ten regular neighbours, a new paper each day. Running the shop means holding onto life.
5431930.name: 旧物小铺

5433870.desc: Survive a night of Chinese folklore in Ghosts Before Dawn, a pixel-art survivor-like. Wield auto-casting talismans, flying swords, and spirit-banishing gongs. Combine weapons and the Five Elements, brave haunted villages and ghost markets, then face the final bosses after ten minutes of survival.
5433870.name: Ghosts Before Dawn

5434650.desc: A short cozy building and management sim set in the sleepy waterways of Kerala, India. A once-mighty village boat club is being revived decades later. Design and build a race-worthy boat, manage the club and its funds through its comeback season.
5434650.name: Rhythm of the Backwaters

5435190.desc: A five-in-a-row board game with an engine that explains itself: every move comes with the shape it built, the threat it answered and the alternatives it weighed. Learn from ten lessons and 1,680 proven puzzles, review your games move by move, and play ranked online or entirely offline.
5435190.name: GomokuZero

5436520.desc: Catch a fish and you become the fish. Catch a car, become the car.
5436520.name: Fishing Up The Food Chain

5437060.desc: Your tabletop RPG, together on LAN or online. Join and play free with characters, dice, animated movement and session messages. Full Toolkit DLC unlocks campaign creation, grid and gridless maps, content editors and GM hosting. Optional accounts connect your community.
5437060.name: Game Master

5437570.desc: Create your character, pick your starting gear, and settle into a rented cabin in this immersive, relaxing life simulator. Forage, work odd jobs, sell junk at the thrift store, and keep yourself fed and clean as you save up for the cabin of your dreams.
5437570.name: Cabin Life

5437650.desc: The classic online strategy game of empires and ancient artifacts, reborn. Found cities, raise armies of thousands and race rival players across a living world to seize the legendary Artifacts. Free to play, with one account on PC, browser and phone.
5437650.name: Artifact Reforged

5438460.desc: Cyberpunk pixel-art auto-shooter. Your weapons fire on their own: you dodge bullet curtains, freeze the battlefield with Stasis, and pick 1 of 3 new weapons every floor. Climb 50 floors across 5 worlds and take down 10 bosses.
5438460.name: STASIS PROTOCOL

5438730.desc: Fishing Shop: Tidy Up is a relaxing first-person game where you bring order to a messy fishing shop. Pick up scattered items, sort them by category, color, and size, place them on the right shelves, upgrade your abilities, and choose music to match your mood!
5438730.name: Fishing Shop: Tidy Up

5439420.desc: Embark on your adventure with player from all over the world! Lead your Angel team to reveal the ancient mysteries of Galaxy…… Welcome to Angel legion, a free RPG gacha game with good fun!
5439420.name: Angel Legion-DLC Starlit Veil Dance (Orange)

5440370.desc: Command a customizable cat in this 3D tower defense game. Build elemental cannons, research new defenses, deploy cat-piloted aircraft, and repel waves of mice. Face bosses, tackle daily sieges, and create and share maps through Steam Workshop.
5440370.name: Meowstone Siege

5441160.desc: You are the last squirrel standing. Perched on your treetop platform, draw your repeating crossbow and hold off wave after wave of wolves, bees and groundhogs. Build auto-turrets, chain power-ups, defend the tree.
5441160.name: Squirrel Defender VR

5443350.desc: Chisel Me This is a 1-8 player party game where you and your friends compete to create statues of various prompts. Sculpt large marble blocks, mold clay, and sabotage competitors as you create artistic masterpieces!
5443350.name: Chisel Me This

5444340.desc: The Claw and Conjure demo is an async PvP auto-battler with fantasy RPG units. Upgrade your town to synergize with your build, then race into battle against real players. The demo offers free access to early game units, items, and abilities and allows PvP play for 8 rounds per run
5444340.name: Claw and Conjure Demo

5444410.desc: Battle enemy hordes, build powerful ability combinations, and defeat challenging bosses in this single-player bullet heaven roguelike. Choose distinct characters, unlock evolutions, and earn permanent upgrades—all with offline gameplay.
5444410.name: Dungeon Survivor

5444950.desc: Collect spinning tops, mix parts and take on rivals and tournaments! Run your own top shop, team up with friends in online co-op, or bring your custom build into a 1v1 battle.
5444950.name: Topsmith: Spinning Top Shop Simulator

5446260.desc: Immerse yourself in the nostalgic atmosphere of early 2000s Russia as you investigate the theft of a city relic. Interact with unique characters, make difficult decisions, and find your path. Save your hometown or feed it to the fiends.
5446260.name: Lestvitsa

5449250.desc: A block-stacking puzzle game for friends. Drop pieces onto one shared board that grows with your group, clear lines together, draft perks and survive random events. Or battle in team duels up to 4v4 and free-for-all matches for up to 10 players. Plus a 40-level campaign.
5449250.name: Quadora

5449940.desc: Furry Witch Fox is a cozy Halloween furry clicker starring an adorable fox witch! Collect hearts, buy upgrades, catch ghosts, and unlock 45 colorful illustrations. Pumpkins, candles, and the comforting magic of Halloween await!
5449940.name: Furry Witch Fox

5450030.desc: Every sheep on the farm has escaped from its stand. Catch them, carry them home and put each one back in its own spot. Hats, costumes, a whole meadow of runaways and a few silly tools to help. A cosy, woolly tidy up game.
5450030.name: We Have a Sheep Problem

5450430.desc: The yacht is a dinghy. The wheel is a hubcap. The fish are something else.
5450430.name: Hillbilly Yacht Club: Fishing

5451120.desc: Recruit Three Kingdoms heroes and build a five-unit team. Combine faction synergies, merge heroes, and use equipment and stratagems to prepare for automatic battles. Every shop visit and formation choice shapes your run through an ink-painted age of conflict.
5451120.name: Three Kingdoms: Gambit of Chaos

5451260.desc: Your store. Your robot. Your code. Code Market is a relaxed management game where you don't click to sell — you program. A robot works in your supermarket, and it does exactly what your Java or C# code tells it: walk to a rack, pick up tomatoes, take a customer's order, pack the bag.
5451260.name: Code Market

5451420.desc: A first-person 3D online murder mystery for you and your friends. Each player takes a role, walks the same crime scene, hunts for clues, and argues their way to the truth. Start with a free case. For paid episodes, one player buys and the whole group joins.
5451420.name: Murder Mystery Online

5451960.desc: Demo of CHU: The Nightmare of That Day. Long after your discharge, you wake up back in the barracks: live through Day 1 and the first night with “him” still awake, then take on spin-off Chapter 1, The Silent Monastery, in 1-4 player online co-op. The full game launches January 14, 2027.
5451960.name: 추 : 그날의 악몽 Demo

5452870.desc: Guide a cute, drifting sunfish through an underwater cave in this 2D side-scrolling action game. Dodge rocks, rubbish, shells, anemones, fish and charging orcas. Ride powerful currents, beat your best distance, and retry instantly when one collision ends your run.
5452870.name: MANBOU / VOYAGE

5454060.desc: Episode 1 of Murder Mystery Online. On a full-moon night, five people gather at a mountain shrine for an all-night rite — and within an hour the shaman is dead. Nine hours until morning. 5 players, 120+ min. One purchase lets the whole group play.
5454060.name: Murder Mystery Online - 초치성

5454720.desc: Combine weapon modules, collect relics and spread fire in this rogue-lite horde survivor. Choose your route, complete missions and take down giant bosses, then head back to your truck before the "Seep" engulfs you!
5454720.name: Dreadmiles

5455040.desc: Organize your Windows desktop with a customizable dock. Pin apps, drag icons into place, preview open windows and switch between them. Choose any screen edge, automatic hiding, hover magnification, and light or dark themes.
5455040.name: Dock Window

5455560.desc: Ten fortresses, one river, five against five. Build your base, train an army of up to a hundred units and break the enemy HQs with your team in fast real-time strategy battles. Free to play, with cross-play between PC, iPhone and Android.
5455560.name: Command Base Assault

5455960.desc: A black-and-white incremental game about one revolving door. Turn it, let people in, and spend the earnings on a bigger door and better blades, until the corner shop's little door is a human pump swallowing the whole city. The goal: admit all of humanity.
5455960.name: Round and Round Inc.

5457010.desc: 777 HERO is a pixel-art idle RPG that captures all the heart-pounding moments of pachinko! And of course! It's built so that even people who know nothing about pachinko can have plenty of fun, so don't worry! The controls are super simple too!
5457010.name: 777 HERO ~The One Who Defies Time~

5457250.desc: Kasumi, a maid café waitress in Akihabara, inherits her late father's safety-pin factory. Make pins, ship them, upgrade wacky machines, retool for global trends, and join her mom and sisters in chasing No.1 world share and a planet of safety pins. A pixel-art incremental factory comedy.
5457250.name: Minami Co.

5457920.desc: Recolor sprites and entire asset folders with multiple palettes. Preview changes, preserve selected colors, adjust shading and dithering, and export variations for your game or art workflow. Includes palette tools and command-line batch processing.
5457920.name: ColorCraft

5459270.desc: A brutal top-down shooter inspired by DOS-era classics, ASCII graphics, arcade shoot 'em ups, and gloriously over-the-top '80s action movies. Fight through Campaign, Endless, and Horde modes, then create your own carnage with the built-in level editor and Steam Workshop support. NO MERCY!
5459270.name: Revenge on the 13th Floor

5460000.desc: Episode 2 of Murder Mystery Online. In a snowbound village, the head of the youth co-op is found dead in a wardrobe — dead for three days, yet everyone heard from them during those days. Why did no one open that door? 5–6 players, 120+ min. One purchase lets the whole group play.
5460000.name: Murder Mystery Online - 사흘

5460060.desc: Commander, sixteen enemy officers stand between your armoured train and the end of the war. Beat them in card battles and they join your squad. Pour the whiskey in your quarters to unlock their animated scenes, uncensored. One purchase. No microtransactions.
5460060.name: Debriefed : Frontline Command

5461500.desc: Five a side, top down, thumbs on. Arcade football with a whole international season underneath it. 195 nations, one midfielder: you.
5461500.name: Football B-side

5461870.desc: A first-person sci-fi social deduction game for up to 8 players. Fix the ship, watch your crewmates, then accuse and vote out the infected. Or be Patient 0: lie, sabotage and vanish. A co-op mode swaps the traitor for a hunter and a ticking clock.
5461870.name: Synthetic Quorum

5462360.desc: Made by someone with nearly 10 years in a gyudon (beef bowl) shop. A first-person shop sim where you wash rice, simmer beef, plate bowls, juggle IH burners and ring up orders like the real job. Run out of rice and the shop closes. Shout through the lunch rush solo or with up to 4 friends online.
5462360.name: 牛丼店シミュレーター

5463460.desc: VELTARUM is a single-player retro FPS built around fast movement and brutal combat. Wall-run through a dark world of towers and chains, fight with guns and a sword, slow time, and face towering bosses. Spend crystals on upgrades between lives and climb again.
5463460.name: Veltarum

5463830.desc: 2D action game featuring exhilarating gameplay driven by dashes and combos. Keep an eye on the actions and reactions of Spica—a cool yet adorable boy who wields the power of the stars! With over 30 stages, the game offers plenty of replay value through features like score attacks and time trials.
5463830.name: StarsPartyNext

5465850.desc: High-speed anti-gravity racing across 16 tracks. Take on 15 rivals, master banked corners, loops and jumps, and spend your energy on perfectly timed boosts. Unlock 12 distinct ships and compete for victory across four Grand Prix cups.
5465850.name: FLUX CIRCUIT

5465870.desc: Stack zombies, clear lines, and chase high scores! Zombie Mori! is a fast-paced falling-block puzzle game packed with quirky zombies! Clear multiple lines, combine zombie types for huge score multipliers, and unlock all 50 zombies in your collection. The higher you stack, the higher you score!
5465870.name: ゾンビ盛り！

5466110.desc: Free Issue 00 includes an exclusive special stage of the wild run & gun HIJURA SCARLET GEAR! A disk-magazine-style collection of indie studio HU-GA's work, also with the Final Re:Quest movie trailer in TRUE PIXEL, a special booklet and four Zolge Station talk specials. New issues arrive as DLC.
5466110.name: ZOLGE STATION: HUGA Waiwai Academy

5467590.desc: Neon-noir beat 'em up for 1-2 players. Includes PART I: STREETS OF VENGEANCE, PART II: OVERCLOCK and SURVIVAL MODE: two full campaigns, couch co-op, combos, throws, support strikes and 13 boss fights, told in painted comic panels.
5467590.name: IRON FURY

5469110.desc: Work the night shift at a 24-hour drive-thru. Take orders, cook the food and hand it out the window. But some customers aren’t human. Check every face, car and order, and refuse the ones that don’t match, or they’ll come back for you before dawn. Solo or co-op for up to 4 players.
5469110.name: 3AM Drivethrough

5469310.desc: Start with an empty account and load the first cargo yourself. Hire and train workers, add wagons and expand your station and warehouse. In this railway idle game, watch the flow of goods, spot bottlenecks and decide which upgrade will make the biggest difference.
5469310.name: Haste Makes Waste

5471970.desc: An endless pile of paperwork is waiting for your approval stamp. Reject shameless "business expenses," outwork your rivals, and from New Hire to Chairman, work until the day you die!
5471970.name: Rubber Stamp Legend

5471990.desc: You watched the defragmenter as a kid. Now it's your turn. Sweep the read head across scrambled disks, hear fragments click into place, and upgrade your machine from a 1998 floppy to a 2032 archive array, recovering thirty years of one ordinary life along the way.
5471990.name: Disk Defragmenter

5472000.desc: Your grandpa is giving you his old farm! Clean it up, plant vegetables, take care of the animals, and make friends in the small village of Lindenau. Go fishing, explore caves, and help the village fight back against a big scheme from the city. Play alone or with up to 3 friends.
5472000.name: Cloverstead

5472080.desc: SHRED A BILLION is a first-person incremental game about a mountain of money! Grab bills by hand, scoop them with a bucket, level up and feed a billion dollars to the shredder. Only 3,929,120,202 bills left to go!
5472080.name: SHRED A BILLION

5472130.desc: Blast your friends off floating arenas in Rocket Punt, a chaotic rocket party brawler for up to 10 players. Grab wild weapons, dodge incoming rockets, and fight solo or in teams across seven modes. Play online with friends or practise against bots.
5472130.name: Rocket Punt

5472270.desc: The most emotionally charged horror game. Find all the pictures before the entities find you.
5472270.name: Backrooms Found Hentai

5472580.desc: A large-scale sorting simulator set in a two-storey hypermarket: organize 65,146 products and boxes across 23 departments, stock shelves and warehouse racks, and use boosters to find, carry and place items.
5472580.name: Hypermarket: Sort & Stock

5472820.desc: This Skylines-themed book unlocks 20 additional levels for Coloring Pixels. Travel the world's cities and beyond in this new book! Iconic, famous, and fictional cities!
5472820.name: Coloring Pixels - Skylines Pack

5472850.desc: Incremental factory + automation clicker + vending machines + steampunk = Vendilooper. Build a snack empire you can get lost watching. Automate refills, stack machines into towers, and feed trains and rockets to Mars. How many snacks can you vend per minute?
5472850.name: Vendilooper - original

5473910.desc: A turn-based RPG about hamster cosmonauts. Roaches hired by space pirates have stolen the Golden Sunflower. Lead five heroes through 170 levels in five worlds, beat the bosses and bring the petals home.
5473910.name: Space Hamsters

5474650.desc: A minimalistic, top down, survival horror. Run, strategise and outplay The Horror accross multiple maps and modes.
5474650.name: The Horror

5475240.desc: Explore a shifting fantasy world in Riftgrove, a 3D action RPG featuring four playable classes, fast-paced combat, procedurally generated wilderness, dangerous dungeons, rare relics, and powerful Champions. Return to Haven, take guild contracts, and venture through the next portal.
5475240.name: RIFTGROVE

5476500.desc: The exclusive soundtrack from Hidden Cats in Beijing is here!
5476500.name: Hidden Cats in Beijing Soundtrack

5476640.desc: FIRE CHESS is a serious strategy game that puts players in command of an emergency-response team to contain spreading wildfires. Recruit and manage units across a hex-grid map, use your limited resources to contain a spreading fire, protect residential communities, and respond to critical alerts.
5476640.name: FIRE CHESS

5476770.desc: Armed Prisoner III is a 2D casual incremental idle electronic cricket small game in which the core gameplay revolves around Bot AI characters using modern firearms to shoot and fight each other. The battles are random, chaotic, and unlimited in duration
5476770.name: Armed Prisoner III

5477110.desc: Xianxia auto-battler: 42 cultivators, 7 elements, 14 bonds. Eight teams, 100 Embers each — lose them all and you are out. No fixed finish line: fight until you ascend or fall. Your rivals are real lineups left by other players — AI stand-ins when the player pool is thin.
5477110.name: Ascension Tournament

5477320.desc: Break the support. Drop the slab. Smash the rock below. Rockburst is an incremental mining game about setting off collapses, collecting ore and buying upgrades to dig deeper before your lamp runs out.
5477320.name: Rockburst

5477930.desc: Your cat borrowed eight million, built a second sun in the bathroom, and named you guarantor. An absurd comedy visual novel with dubious contracts, a bathtub republic, a turn-based solar puzzle, and three ways to survive the evening.
5477930.name: Boris & the Second Sun

5478920.desc: "Magnetaris" takes you to an unknown planet, battered by electrical storms and strongly affected by magnetic fields. You will have to stabilize it using new technologies and machinery. Alone or with friends, explore these magnetic lands, unveil their secrets, and restore balance to this planet!
5478920.name: The Planet Crafter - Magnetaris

5480010.desc: Relive your Battle Bears childhood with 3 classic skins from the Trilogy Era (Classic Oliver, Classic Riggs and Classic Huggable) designed with superfan artist AceArts, 3 classic songs for the menu and map jukebox, and 100 Gas Cans to spend in game.
5480010.name: Battle Bears Gold - Classic Skins & Jukebox Songs

5480030.desc: Go Overclock! Use 2 Overclock gauntlets with Oliver for a unique play style, including the brand new Dark OCO Gauntlet. Plus 5 Overclock skins, including 3 brand-new ones designed with superfan artist AceArts, the Overclock menu theme for the jukebox, and 150 Gas Cans to spend in-game.
5480030.name: Battle Bears Gold - Overclock Skins, Weapons & Jukebox Song

5480040.desc: THIS PACK SHALL SHOWER GOLD UPON EVERY CLASS PRESENT AND FUTURE! Never go unnoticed on the battlefield again with 11 gold skins, one for every class! It wouldn't be Battle Bears Gold without them.
5480040.name: Battle Bears Gold - Gold Skins Pack

5480060.desc: Smash the competition with Bling Pong, a close-range table tennis weapon crafted from Gold Digger materials by artist AceArts. Includes instant unlocks for 6 unreleased DLC tracks and, we're not joking, 1,000 BONUS GAS CANS!
5480060.name: Battle Bears Gold - Bling Pack: Weapon, Rare Songs & Gas

5480320.desc: A pixel shooter with automatic fire, random loot, and permanent upgrades. Steer your fighter left and right, combining gear, relics, and items packed with memes. Spend gold on the skill tree, chase survival records, and face a boss with three phases. Your next chest might hold a surprise!
5480320.name: ！？龙龙？！

5482330.desc: Wayfarion is a 2D space action roguelite. Chart procedural sectors, fight in real time, fit weapons and drones, and trade loot at starports. A destroyed ship ends the run, while skill-tree licenses and unlocked hulls carry over. Play solo or in online co-op.
5482330.name: Wayfarion

5482350.desc: Become Rinnosuke, owner of the Kourindou curio shop, and play chess with the Gensokyo regulars who drop by. Your guests laugh, panic and grumble as the game turns. Learn the rules in a 9-chapter story, then sharpen your play with puzzles and lessons.
5482350.name: Touhou Chess

5482540.desc: Conduct an orchestra with your mouse as the baton. The catch: they're terrible. The flute can't be heard, the horn is deafening, and the choir in Beethoven's Ninth only sings "Aaah". Had enough? Throw the baton at them. Instruments break, the damage piles up, and they throw it back.
5482540.name: MISCONDUCTOR | 迷指揮者

548430.desc: Deep Rock Galactic is a 1-4 player co-op FPS featuring dwarven space miners, procedurally-generated destructible environments, and endless hordes of alien monsters. Explore cave systems, mine for minerals, and work together to survive!
548430.name: Deep Rock Galactic

5484400.desc: A relaxing first-person sim about tidying up a forgotten military underground base. Shelve ammo crates, weapons, drones and gear, unlock new sectors and level up your skills – solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. No timers, no pressure.
5484400.name: Military Base Tidy Up

5485330.desc: Turn piles of plush cats into tidy shelves! So Many Cats! is a cozy first-person organizing game. Sort 4,608 plushies, unlock abilities and decorate your shop. No timers, no rush. Just one more cat!
5485330.name: So Many Cats!

5486000.desc: A couch co-op spellcaster for one to four players. Aim every spell by hand, jump what you cannot walk around, and read fifteen bespoke bosses well enough not to burn your friends. Friendly fire is always on.
5486000.name: Emberveth

5486980.desc: A solo card game with one deck. Clubs and spades are monsters. Diamonds are weapons. Hearts are potions. Each round deals 4 cards: play 3, keep 1. Get through the deck alive. Every deck can be won. A new daily deck every day, and rogue runs of six decks.
5486980.name: Grim Deck

5487470.desc: A first-person multiplayer social deduction game: investigate, craft equipment and expose the parasite, or play as the creature to hide inside other players, take control of their bodies and turn their trust against them.
5487470.name: Parasite: Among the Guests

5488250.desc: Hunt zombies, collect powerful loot, and grow stronger in this third-person action RPG. Find pistols, assault rifles, shotguns, and equipment with randomized stats and effects, build your character, fight through five increasingly dangerous stages, and ultimately challenge the Zomking.
5488250.name: Zomking

5489480.desc: Just Lay It is a train survival strategy game where you lay tracks, gather resources, and fight monsters to keep a train running across the desert. Defend against waves of enemies and design efficient routes to reach your destination safely. The moment the train stops, survival ends.
5489480.name: JustLayIt

5490440.desc: SKY REAVER is a pixel-art vertical shoot 'em up with incremental progression. Dodge bullets, destroy enemies and collect resources. Return to base for permanent upgrades, unlock missiles, wingmen and lasers, and take on 25 powerful bosses with ever-growing firepower.
5490440.name: SKY REAVER

5490870.desc: Change gravity in six directions and guide crystal orbs to their goals in this single-player 3D puzzle game. Choose any of 100 stages from the start. EXTRA HARD adds XOR gates, water controls and floating platforms in larger mazes. Team up with Meguru and Bimba to earn minimum-move medals!
5490870.name: Horochi's Challenge

5493320.desc: Supporter pack with the Grimguard Armor, Chaos Glider and matching cape cosmetics
5493320.name: Stormforge - Supporter Pack Cosmetics

5493880.desc: A darkly funny bunker management sim. Build down, admit survivors at the gate and pray none of them is infected. Every night something new tests your layout: diggers from below, crawlers in the vents, spores in the air, screamers drawn to your generators.
5493880.name: Home Sweet Bunker: Bunker Tycoon

5494200.desc: Discover the joy of learning Chinese: connect characters into words across 30 ink-wash themes, planned to grow to 100. Every word includes pinyin, English meaning, and audio. The interface stays in Chinese for immersion - hover any button for an English tip. Zen Mode or 3-minute Challenge.
5494200.name: Hanzen: A Chinese Word Journey

5494940.desc: Turn a forgotten mountain street into a cozy yokai night bazaar. Gather ingredients, choose stalls, and let an odd little crew get to work. Keep recipes between runs, learn lasting upgrades, and prepare seven lantern-lit festivals.
5494940.name: Yokai Night Bazaar

5495500.desc: The official one-track MANBOU / VOYAGE soundtrack. Includes Bubble Plunge by teihen0gc (1:00.447), in 320 kbps stereo MP3 format. Music created using Gemini generative AI.
5495500.name: MANBOU / VOYAGE Soundtrack

5496540.desc: Heavy punches, big bellies and scores to settle. Street Panz is a single-player 2D fighting game: choose from eight fighters, take on the neighborhood rivals and four bosses, sharpen your moves and climb the local leaderboard.
5496540.name: Street Panz

5498450.desc: inFADErs is a barbershop simulator where every hair on your customer's head is real. Thousands of strands grow, fall, flop when wet and stand up when dry, and every one of them is judged when the cut is done.
5498450.name: inFADErs

550.desc: Set in the zombie apocalypse, Left 4 Dead 2 is a co-operative action horror FPS takes you and your friends through the cities, swamps and cemeteries of the Deep South, from Savannah to New Orleans across five expansive campaigns.
550.name: Left 4 Dead 2

5500200.desc: The companion that turns your next battle around might still be inside an egg—hatch your team, brave dice-driven turn-based battles, and journey from sunlit shores to snowy wilds and distant star realms.
5500200.name: Dicekin: Monster Tamer

5501320.desc: Help a floating island restore life in VR
5501320.name: Asian Story

5501670.desc: A weather and disaster expansion for The City. Track storms on the forecast, then watch your city face lightning, hail, floods, forest fires, earthquakes and EF0 to EF5 tornadoes. Build sirens, shelters, levees and seawalls, drain flooded streets, insure your buildings and rebuild.
5501670.name: The City - Force of Nature

5502530.desc: Build a tiny world in a jar. Layer gravel, charcoal, moss and soil, plant ferns and succulents, then add frogs, a box turtle, snails, ladybugs or a few fireflies. Give it its own weather: a little sun, a rain cloud, a thunderstorm, snow. Share it or sell it on the marketplace and become a tycoon!
5502530.name: Terrarium Tycoon

5502660.desc: The original soundtrack to EVERYBODY HATES YOU IN TOKYO, composed and arranged by Tayfun Tuna.
5502660.name: Everybody Hates You in TOKYO Soundtrack
